item.title: blaris: Windowless Random-Access LZSS for Constrained Microcontrollers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：嵌入式 LZ77 解压器（heatshrink、tamp）需要 RAM 滑动窗口，内存占用与压缩率耦合，且随机访问读延迟高。

方法：blaris 轻量无窗口 LZSS 解压器，面向受限微控制器的 XIP 随机访问：把 token 划分为双向可遍历流并设 2 的幂检查点，直接在压缩载荷内解析反向引用，不分配 RAM 窗口；面向 compress-on-host/decompress-on-device 工作流，假设可信构建期载荷，省略运行时错误与边界检查。

关键数字：压缩率与高窗口 heatshrink/tamp 配置相当；RV32IMC 上仅需 548-784 B Flash、104-112 B 总 RAM；小片随机读比比例匹配的块索引 heatshrink/tamp 快数量级。

为什么值得看：把解压器的内存占用与压缩率解耦，为闪存直接执行场景提供极低资源开销的随机访问解压。

item.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产 LLM 长上下文用稀疏注意力，但 serving 仍须保留完整 KV 历史，GPU HBM 容量限制并发；现有 KV offload 到 host 内存受 PCIe 带宽与 host 容量双重限制。

方法：分析发现即便有 scale-up 内存池，解码吞吐仍被 HBM 容量钳制——热 KV 缓冲与常驻索引器 key 缓存（K-index）占用大量 HBM 且访问模式不同；XM-Sparse 首个基于 scale-up 内存扩展的稀疏注意力 offload 系统：动态 KV 条目用 TMA 检索与注意力做 tile 级流水线融合隐藏延迟，可预测 K-index 访问用 SM 高效 GPU-initiated DMA 预取并避开解码关键路径。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.3 + 模拟 scale-up 内存池：解码吞吐比 PCIe 的 ECHO 高 4.98×、比 HiSparse 高 4.52×，同平台比 naive 集成高 1.34×，覆盖 16K-1M 上下文。

为什么值得看：首个面向 scale-up 内存池的稀疏注意力 offload 系统，按两类缓存的访问模式分别定制 I/O 机制。

阅读原文

item.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

专家构建任务上的 RL 对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的训练

We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rule…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

权重空间编程给扩散编辑带来什么

Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing and rewriting the Astra programs then raises CLIP by +6.2 points while joint success changes by -9.7. On a fixed 144-image sample, five additional evaluators give point estimates in the same directions under whole-image target matching; checks of su…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

权重空间编程不需要 Transformer 的实证

Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretra…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

从运动轨迹读车辆尺寸与动力类型的数据集

Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and li…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

把 LLM 变成表格分类器（Visa 十亿级微调）

Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. Our paper provides an en…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：核化注意力方法宣称用 O(N) 替代 softmax 的 O(N²)，但五年研究缺乏跨方法、跨规模的系统评估与公平比较。

方法：分效率与质量两半剖析：效率侧对比 FlashAttention 与 SOTA 核化方法（训练与视觉 transformer）；质量侧用统一蒸馏协议评测；提出 LARA++，通过重要性采样 + 自适应提议分布逼近 softmax。

关键数字：FlashAttention 在训练与视觉 transformer 的大多数序列长度上内存更低、墙钟更快（因果 LM 推理内存是唯一明确例外），且核化方法的效率收益常无法在现代基线上复现；统一蒸馏协议下核化方法相对 softmax 有 2-10 分差距，模型规模本身不闭合差距；LARA++ 恢复 softmax 精度最高 99%，但计算开销仍大，效率墙未破。

为什么值得看：核化注意力的系统化"现实核查"，证明差距可闭合但代价未消除，是该方向少见的公允横评。

阅读原文

item.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

检索增强 VLM 的证据权衡基准（20 万条）

Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 越来越常以低精度部署，但量化会损害性能；量化如何与采样温度、top-p 等解码设置相互作用？

方法：测量生成熵发现量化平均"加热"模型，且温度对量化模型的影响远大于全精度模型；TempQuant 学习量化模型的温度与 top-p，使其 next-token 概率更接近全精度模型；分两粒度——每请求温度一个全局设置（无需标签即找到接近标签调优的温度），以及逐 token 设置（排名翻转的 token 需加热、排名保持的需冷却）。

关键数字：3-bit Qwen3-4B 上，全局 TempQuant 把 MATH 精度从量化官方推荐配置下的 34% 提升到 51%。

为什么值得看：挑战"量化模型应与全精度模型用相同采样设置"的默认做法，给出无需标签的解码设置校准方法。

item.title: TAILROLL: Tail-Aware Rollout Acceleration for RL-Based LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

RL 后训练的尾部感知 rollout 加速，区分失衡与拖尾浪费

RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by rollout: heavy-tailed responses leave engines idle as each step waits for the longest response. Asynchronous training masks, but does not eliminate, idle time. We distinguish imbalance waste (uneven placement and decode contention) from straggler waste (waiting for the longest response). Tail length, not average load, often sets the step bound. We propose TAILROLL, an online scheduler integrated into an open-source RL framework. It combines stateless in-flight migration and sufficiency-gated termination. Migration moves decoding requests between engines at chunk boundaries and resumes them with one re-prefill under a freeness-based, cost-aware tail-balancing policy. Termination stops a response when its GRPO group has enough completed samples for advantage estimation, masking its partial output from the training loss. Across ten configurations, TAILROLL reduces rollout bubble ratio by 21% to 74% and cross-engine KV-cache imbalance by 44% to 79%. In end-to-end RL training, it cuts rollout time by 24% to 34%, full step time by 21% to 22% on long-CoT RL, and p95 request latency by 28% to 37%, while raising generation …

item.title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

合成晶体数据用于扩散预训练

Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control wi…

item.title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Gemma 4 31B 全局注意力层中 value 是归一化 key 投影、key 是 value 乘固定权重（旋转位置编码占四分之一维度）；官方报告称该设计可降全局 KV cache 至多 37.5%，但开源 serving 引擎仍存完整 key+value（每 KV head 每 token 1,024 值）。

方法：只存一行 640 值（实数算术下精确），未改动的 paged attention 核通过两个重叠 strided 视图把它同时读作 key cache 与 value cache；在 vLLM 原型中验证 16-bit 31B 模型。

关键数字：输出与模拟逐位一致，432 个最终答案中仅 2 个与 stock 引擎不同（在其 run-to-run 噪声内）；32K-64K token 时每请求稳态解码 KV 内存降 1.34-1.40×；双 A100 + NIXL + CPU offload 下 16K-token prompt 解码 token 数 1.38×、8K 为 1.24×；eager 解码吞吐升 1.30/1.11×，等 batch 下 eager 步骤慢 4-9%。

为什么值得看：利用 Gemma 4 31B 的结构冗余做"只存一次 KV"的精确内存节省，且不改注意力核、输出逐位一致。

item.title: Spatially local mini-batching for implicit neural representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

隐式神经表示的局部空间小批量

Neural surrogates based on implicit neural representations (INRs) are typically trained on mini-batches spread over the whole domain, since a generic INR loses accuracy when every point of a batch lies in one small region. We show that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs), INRs whose weight matrices are products of shared bases with coefficients emitted by a small hypernetwork, can be trained with spatially local mini-batches. Each step uses the points of one time snapshot of an adaptive-mesh numerical solution inside one small cell, with snapshots and cells drawn according to the refinement of the mesh. We posit that such training is enabled by the structural property of LRNRs, as a local step reaches the shared bases only through the $r$ coefficients of each layer, and keeps one cell from rewriting the network. By a Kolmogorov-width argument, we show that when restricted to a small cell, the hidden states of LRNRs lie close to a low-dimensional subspace, which suggests the local steps only affect low-rank subspaces of the shared bases. On six hyperbolic-conservation-law problems with solutions computed using adaptive mesh refinement, one local training recipe reaches 1.1-2.3% …

item.title: Similarity-Aware Client-Side Reordering for Server-Side Storage Compression in Distributed File Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

分布式文件系统服务端存储压缩的客户端重排

As growing data volumes strain the capacity of distributed file systems, server-side storage compression transparently reduces disk usage, but its effectiveness is limited when similar blocks land in separate compression records and cannot share matches. We present a client-side reordering framework that transforms the physical block layout before persistence, so that related blocks are co-located within the same compression scope without replacing the existing storage-server compressor. It operates on bounded reordering windows, periodically selects among candidate layouts via lightweight compression of sampled data, and recovers the original logical order during reads with compact window-local metadata. We implement the framework in the SkyFS distributed file system, using the Zstandard (Zstd) compressor on the OpenZFS storage backend. Results on diverse datasets show that the framework reduces physical storage by up to 42.9% relative to logical-order writes, while achieving 94-108% of baseline sequential-read throughput and 91-99% of random-read IOPS. Client-side layout construction is the primary additional write cost, showing that adaptive similarity-aware reordering substanti…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：知识蒸馏研究手段多样，但工具没有跟上：现有工具包通常只支持有限子集技术与用例。

方法：SilverSpoon-KD 开源 PyTorch 工具包，用单一 API 统一不同蒸馏范式与架构关系，跨视觉、掩码 LM、因果 LM 负载验证，覆盖同构/异构/量化蒸馏；提供首个通用 blockwise 知识蒸馏实现，带独特可扩展特性；在便利性、指标计算与追踪之外，与既有工具包对比吞吐与 GPU 内存。

关键数字：性能与既有工具包持平或更好（吞吐、GPU 内存对比评估）。

为什么值得看：蒸馏工具缺口的一次系统性补齐，通用 blockwise 蒸馏实现是其中独有的能力。

item.title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

视觉-语言融合的缩放定律

Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. We derive a scaling law that unifiedly describes these dynamics, enabling accurate loss predictions across mixture ratios, training steps, and model sizes. Crucially, our law characterizes the trade-off between early and late fusion: under a fixed data budget, early fusion preserves text performance while late fusion favors visio…

多维用户偏好数据下 LLM 对齐的样本高效个性化

Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. item.title: SPICE: Sparse Parameter Gossip for LLM Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：跨地理分布式资源预训练 LLM 需要受限且波动互联网带宽下的通信高效方法；去中心化训练用 peer 交换替代全局集合通信，但全模型消息使更大 peer 邻域成本高昂。

方法：SPICE 组合稀疏参数 gossip 与纠错反馈，通过修正后的参数值让消息在 peer 邻域变化时保持直接可解释；稀疏交换使更宽邻域可负担。

关键数字：副本数增长时 SPICE 增加联系的 peer 数而保持单条消息稀疏，限制 dense gossip 的质量退化；带宽约束下吞吐高于 DDP 与 dense gossip，并在链路瞬时降速时维持吞吐。

为什么值得看：用"稀疏消息 + 宽邻域"替代"全模型消息 + 窄邻域"，为广域分布式预训练提供通信效率新方案。

item.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

LLM 排行榜的赢家诅咒实证

Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $Θ(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points. In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points. Such overstatement is large enough to make the apparent winner statistically fragile. Thus, we use the same bootstrap to further quantify the intervals of plausible rank positions for each model and group m…

item.title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

奖励知情方向探索的扩散 RL

Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. item.title: ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：布尔门/LUT 逻辑网络承诺高效硬件推理，但在深度上训练、学习其连接结构一直困难。

方法：ResoLUT 不把逻辑当逻辑训练——逐层把训练好的 ResNet 蒸馏成 LUT 树，保留多位残差流与 BatchNorm，连接结构从 teacher 提取而非学习；训练与推理全程硬 LUT 决策，避免逻辑中的离散化鸿沟。

关键数字：ResoLUT-20 CIFAR-10 达 95.66%（双倍树）；ResoLUT-56 CIFAR-100 78.87%、ImageNet 64px 53.69%，为逻辑与 LUT 网络在 CIFAR-10/100 上的最佳结果；最优 ResoLUT-8（1/8 树）可上 FPGA，90.04% 精度下 189k 图像/秒，是 >85% 精度对比模型中吞吐最高。

为什么值得看：首个在视觉领域保留 ResNet 式多位残差流的卷积逻辑网络，证明 LUT 网络可以规模化到深度。

item.title: ReMoE: An Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Human Mobility Recovery Forecasting Across Disasters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

灾害后人类移动恢复预测的可解释 MoE

Human mobility often declines sharply following disasters and subsequently exhibits complex recovery dynamics. Effective forecasting of this recovery is critical for timely assessment and resource allocation. However, existing approaches are often developed for individual events and operate as black boxes, limiting their transferability and interpretability beyond the events they were trained on. Recent studies have identified recurring post-disaster mobility recovery types across disasters, suggesting that recovery knowledge may be transferable. Motivated by this, we propose ReMoE, an interpretable mixture-of-experts framework for cross-disaster mobility recovery forecasting. ReMoE uses a feature-guided router to adaptively combine specialized experts that learn these heterogeneous yet reusable recovery types, producing a region-specific recovery pattern. It further refines this pattern through residual correction informed by forecasts of future hazard conditions. We evaluate ReMoE on a large-scale mobility dataset covering 18 disaster events spanning hurricanes, floods, winter storms, and wildfires. ReMoE is competitive in-distribution and achieves the strongest performance on un…

item.title: ReMaRL: Learning to Unmask and Remask in Frozen Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

冻结扩散语言模型中学习去掩码/重掩码策略

Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, and the order in which tokens are unmasked affects final-answer accuracy. Several methods learn unmasking policies from task rewards, but these policies cannot remask earlier predictions. Remasking lets the model correct those predictions using newly generated context. Heuristic rules guide both unmasking and remasking, while supervised remaskers learn to detect token errors. Neither approach directly optimizes these decisions for final-answer correctness. To address this gap, we introduce ReMaRL (Remasking with Reinforcement Learning), a lightweight policy that learns which tokens to unmask, retain, or remask. We train this roughly 0.3M-parameter policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) from final-answer rewards while keeping the diffusion model frozen. With LLaDA-8B-Instruct, ReMaRL achieves the highest scores among the compared unmasking and remasking policies within the tested inference budgets of 4-32 model calls on math and 8-16 calls on code.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Python Code Generation for Isabelle/HOL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

Isabelle/HOL 的 Python 代码生成

The Isabelle theorem prover provides an environment for formalising mathematics and reasoning about programs. To make verified implementations practically usable, its code generator translates functions expressed in the executable fragment of its logic into conventional programming languages. Its targets have traditionally been functional languages (Standard ML, OCaml, Haskell, and Scala), recently joined by Go. Python, which is becoming the dominant language of scientific computing, data science, and education, has remained out of reach. In this work, we close this gap with a Python backend for Isabelle's code generator. This generator enables verified algorithms to be used in Python applications, or to serve as verified references against which established Python libraries can be differentially tested, without leaving the Python ecosystem. We validate the backend on regression suites covering large parts of the HOL library and by testing six verified data structures and algorithms against established Python libraries. The generated code is slower than hand-written libraries, but well suited as a verified reference.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Projected Penalty-Gradient Tracking for Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Resilient Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习的投影惩罚梯度跟踪

We investigate communication-efficient federated learning over heterogeneous datasets in the presence of Byzantine adversaries capable of uploading arbitrary information. Penalty-based methods bound the influence of each worker through the bounded gradient of a penalty function; however, the bound is lost once the uploads are compressed, since a Byzantine worker can accumulate an unbounded state at the server. To retain the Byzantine resilience under compressed uploads, we propose a projected penalty-gradient tracking framework, where each honest worker uploads a compressed residual of its penalty gradient and the server projects each reconstructed state onto the known penalty-gradient ball. The framework accommodates any contractive compressor and yields two algorithms: fault-resilient proximal gradient with consistent sparsification (FRPG-CS), whose shared mask is protected by freshly drawn reserve rows, and lazily aggregated FRPG (LAG-FRPG), whose uploads are event-triggered. item.title: Physically Admissible Generative Flow Matching for Sparse Flow Reconstruction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

稀疏流重建的物理可允许生成流匹配

Reconstructing full fluid velocity fields from sparse, localized observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem: most of the spatial domain remains unobserved, discrete conservation laws must hold strictly, and predictive uncertainty must be reliable. Existing generative models typically enforce physical constraints only at the terminal output or via soft penalties, leaving intermediate generative trajectories unconstrained. We introduce Feasible Subspace Consistency (FSC), a framework that preserves physical admissibility as an invariant of continuous generative dynamics: tangent-space matching confines the entire ODE trajectory to the discrete conservation manifold, while mass-orthonormal coordinates preserve the kinetic-energy metric. Sparse reconstruction then reduces to amortized posterior transport in the latent space of a frozen FSC prior, ensuring every posterior sample inherits incompressibility and boundary conditions without per-sample projection loops. We validate FSC on a periodic Kolmogorov flow, where exact spectral projection isolates path tangency and metric isometry, and a wall-bounded cylinder wake with immersed obstacles, realized via matrix-free iterative…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

模拟电路 sizing 的 agentic EDA 数值优化器

Analog circuit design automation requires both coordinated tool execution and efficient numerical search. Large language models (LLMs) offer new ways to organize tool execution, but finding one sizing that satisfies specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners remains costly. PVTSizing 2.0 addresses these needs through a human-agent workflow built around an independently usable numerical optimizer. An agent carries the designer's approved task through execution and result review. The optimizer reduces unnecessary training through loss-guided updates and uses critic-guided local refinement to explore additional candidates while accounting for cross-corner conflicts. An optional LLM adviser supplies parameter relationships to focus numerical search on circuit-informed directions, while the optimizer selects adjustment amplitudes and verifies their effects through simulation. Across four circuit benchmarks, the standalone optimizer completes all 40 runs and achieves a 7.3x speedup in overall mean runtime over the original PVTSizing, with a comparable mean sample count. 求解 PDE 的并行潜空间神经算子

Aggregating observations into a limited number of latent tokens and learning physical interactions in the latent space has emerged as an effective approach for Transformer-based neural operators to solve Partial Differential Equation (PDE) problems involving large-scale observations. However, existing methods typically compress observations using a single aggregation pattern, making physical information not retained by that pattern invisible to the latent space and thereby constraining physical interactions within it. To address this limitation, we propose PArallel Latent Space Neural Operator (PANO), a novel neural operator for solving PDEs that formulates physical interactions among observations as an additive combination of interaction results from parallel latent spaces with shared parameters. Specifically, PANO transforms observations into multiple distinct compressed representations through independent mappings, learns physical interactions in parallel based on these representations, and finally fuses the decoded results to predict the target physical field. item.title: PAISF: A Partially Adaptive In-Order Selection Function for Routing in On-Chip, Inter-Chiplet, and Wafer-Scale Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

片上/片间/晶圆级网络的部分自适应保序选择函数

The growing number of compute elements per chip, along with advances such as chiplet systems and wafer-scale integration, drives the need for scalable and efficient routing algorithms for irregular topologies. A routing algorithm consists of a routing function (RF) that ensures deadlock freedom and a selection function (SF) that avoids congestion and, in some cases, guarantees in-order packet delivery. We propose two novel SFs for irregular topologies, ISF and PAISF, which ensure in-order delivery by hashing a packet's entropy value to determine its path. Packets with the same entropy follow the same path and arrive in order. Compared to a deterministic RF, a deterministic SF, and Multi, three alternative in-order delivery strategies, (PA)ISF improves throughput by 15.2% and reduces energy per packet and latency under load by 12.1% and 11.3%, at the cost of a zero-load latency increase by 3.3% on average across workloads and topologies.

item.title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

NVIDIA 开源表格基础模型族（27M-214M）

We introduce Kumo Tabular, a family of open tabular foundation models for classification and regression, in three sizes: Kumo Tabular-S (27M parameters), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), and Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Pretrained only on artificial tables from the Kumo prior, they can make predictions on new tables without any training. In our approach, a table encoder compresses each row into an embedding, and an in-context learning transformer predicts the unlabeled rows from the labeled ones. Kumo Tabular introduces architectural innovations that improve both training stability and predictive performance, enabling the model to scale up to 150M cells on modern GPUs. Kumo Tabular-L ranks first on eight benchmarks: TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, and TabBench-Bio. These cover probabilistic regression, tables with over 1M rows or 100K columns, and tables with strings, text, or images. Accuracy improves with model size in all tested comparisons. All three sizes lie on the accuracy-speed frontiers of TabArena and BeyondArena. Kumo Tabular-L predicts faster than the runners-up, LimiX-2 on TabArena (36 times) and TabPFN-3.5 on BeyondArena (1.7 times). Weigh…

item.title: Mixed-Size Placement Initialization via Stiefel-Manifold Sequential Subspace Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

Stiefel 流形序贯子空间优化的混合尺寸布局初始化

Mixed-size global placement simultaneously optimizes the locations of large macros and millions of standard cells in modern very-large-scale integration (VLSI) physical design. State-of-the-art analytical placers achieve strong scalability, but their nonlinear objectives and density handling make them sensitive to the initial placement. This paper presents a geometry-driven framework that formulates placement initialization as a Quadratically Constrained Quadratic Program (QCQP) with first-order centroid and second-order spreading constraints. Explicit mixed-size spreading targets are derived from the die geometry and object sizes, to obtain stable constraint values even under extreme size variation. A utilization-aware rescaling of the constraint matrix prevents pathological spreading when fixed objects occupy significant die area. The QCQP is then transformed into a Stiefel-manifold optimization through metric equalization and centering projection, making the underlying geometric structure explicit. Mixed-size global placement simultaneously optimizes the locations of large macros and millions of standard cells in modern very-large-scale integration (VLSI) physical design. State-of-the-art analytical placers achieve strong scalability, but their nonlinear objectives and density handling make them sensitive to the initial placement. This paper presents a geometry-driven framework that formulates placement initialization as a Quadratically Constrained Quadratic Program (QCQP) with first-order centroid and second-order spreading constraints. Explicit mixed-size spreading targets are derived from the die geometry and object sizes, to obtain stable constraint values even under extreme size variation. A utilization-aware rescaling of the constraint matrix prevents pathological spreading when fixed objects occupy significant die area. The QCQP is then transformed into a Stiefel-manifold optimization through metric equalization and centering projection, making the underlying geometric structure explicit. item.title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：JEPA 潜在世界模型以 MPC 做具身规划，采样式 MPC 每次规划重复数万次预测器推断，高端 GPU 上一步规划仍需数十秒，无法用于真实具身控制。

方法：利用重复推断负载的潜在局部性——量化预测器内相近动作映射为相近潜在、呈差分位级稀疏；由于规划器自己决定候选组合，可用参考森林采样让每组动作序列耦合到共享根以"制造"更多稀疏；将规划器与位级稀疏加速器紧耦合协同设计，硬件按规划器暴露的结构调度。

关键数字：3 个 JEPA 世界模型上比 dense 加速器快 1.28-1.80×、能耗低 38-52%；比先前位稀疏设计快 1.22-1.58×、能耗低 16-36%，面积相同。

为什么值得看：首个规划器主动"制造"位级稀疏、并与硬件协同设计的 JEPA 世界模型规划加速方案。

item.title: LoopPrune: Recurrent Pruning for Looped Diffusion Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环扩散 Transformer 复用共享块加深计算、以更少参数匹配更大模型，但重复的 attention/MLP 计算仍昂贵；训练无关剪枝难以解析循环贡献，训练式方法又缺乏对位置特定误差的显式约束。

方法：LoopPrune 剪枝与恢复框架：循环重要性估计结合共享移除效应与位置变化来选择共享结构；共享重建池化循环输入统计补偿权重；循环位置恢复在相同学生状态比较完整去噪预测并匹配文本引导，对固定 dense teacher 更新全部学生参数。

关键数字：30% 结构化参数剪枝下 Looped-DiT B/16 保持 dense 六基准平均精度 93.14%，超最佳基线 9.49%；剪枝的 SDXSv3 峰值 GPU 内存降 34.36-44.64%、去噪加速 1.46-1.74×（PyTorch/vLLM-Omni/SGLang Diffusion 三栈验证）。

为什么值得看：首个兼顾共享结构选择与位置误差恢复的循环扩散 Transformer 剪枝方案，内存与延迟收益量化完整。

item.title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

推理时目标的分层策略采样

Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

大规模神经元社群发现揭示语言模型神经元稀疏行为

What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model's neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copyi…

item.title: LaFlash: Capacity-Driven Acceleration for Coding Agent Workflows via QLC-HBF
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

QLC-HBF 容量驱动加速 coding agent 工作流

As large language models (LLMs) evolve toward agentic AI, coding agents are emerging as memory-intensive workloads that repeatedly reuse persistent states, including contexts and KV caches. Emerging agentic workflows, including Loop/Graph Engineering, cause state amplification through frequent active/dormant transitions, increasing memory pressure. Evicted states incur costly recomputation upon reactivation, particularly under long-context, short-decode workloads. This motivates Capacity-Driven Acceleration (CDA), which explicitly accounts for state amplification to allocate memory capacity between active concurrency and dormant-state retention, replacing recomputation with memory access. In this work, we propose LaFlash, a High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) architecture that exploits the large capacity of Quad-Level Cell (QLC)-based flash to realize CDA. However, QLC's long read latency demands massive read parallelism under irregular state reactivation and varying context lengths, while limited write endurance constrains placement. LaFlash introduces Session Grouping to balance active request counts and aggregate context lengths across groups, sustaining read parallelism and block utiliz…

item.title: LASH-PAT: Deadlock-Free Adaptive Shortest-Path Routing for Inter-Chiplet Interconnects
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

片间互连的无死锁自适应最短路径路由

With the slowdown of transistor scaling, chipletbased systems, and in particular chiplet-based wafer-scale integration, have emerged as a promising approach to sustain growth in computing capability per cost for modern processors and accelerators. In recent years, many specialized inter-chiplet interconnect topologies have been proposed. In these topologies, the simple, well-established, and deadlock-free dimension-order routing scheme is not applicable due to its reliance on regular mesh structures. In this work, we study routing in these recently proposed inter-chiplet interconnect topologies by categorizing and evaluating nine deadlock-free routing functions for irregular topologies known from data center networking in this new context. This reveals a trade-off between turn-based routing, which enables path diversity, and layered routing, which ensures shortest-path delivery. To resolve this trade-off, we propose LASH-PAT, a routing function that extends layered shortestpath routing with adaptive path diversity. LASH-PAT supports multiple shortest paths and dynamically selects among them based on local congestion while preserving deadlock freedom. When compared to the best-perfo…

item.title: KD-DSE: A Knowledge-Driven LLM Framework for Fast Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

知识驱动 LLM 微架构设计空间探索框架

Domain-specific architectures have made design space exploration (DSE) a bottleneck of processor design, yet each candidate costs a full simulation, so exhaustive search is out of reach. Surrogate models need thousands of simulations before they predict reliably, and LLM agents that search directly hallucinate, lack cold-start architectural knowledge, and follow a fixed per-round policy. We present KD-DSE, a knowledge- driven LLM framework for fast microarchitecture DSE. KD- DSE couples a five-state constrained agent with real gem5- McPAT evaluation, retrieves architect-curated guidance from an Architecture Knowledge Base conditioned on the current search state and bottleneck diagnosis, and allocates its budget with a diagnosis-guided two-phase exploration strategy. On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base. These results indicate that constraining LLM reasoning and grounding it in architectural knowledge can drive fast and effective microarchitecture DSE. The code will be open-sou…

item.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

并行循环 Transformer 的跨轨迹潜注入扩展深度

Parallel Looped Transformers (PLTs) use otherwise idle decoding compute by overlapping recurrent iterations. However, vanilla PLTs scale poorly with depth: they exhibit training-loss spikes, and their quality gains shrink as more loops are added. The benefit of additional loops depends on the information available to each iteration, so we examine whether the existing computational dependencies limit effective depth scaling. We find that only the preceding in-trajectory state is passed across loop boundaries, even though completed cross-trajectory representations are already available. Based on this finding, we propose InfuseLoop, a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism. It aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories through lightweight attention residuals. This design preserves token-parallel training and concurrent loop execution, and requires only $O(Rd)$ additional hidden-state storage. Experiments show that InfuseLoop eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops. At eight loops, InfuseLoop reduces perplexity by 3.4--17.1% relative to vanilla PLTs and by 10.5--37.3% relative to the non-looped base…

item.title: How well does graph superoptimization transfer? Adapting tensor-graph superoptimizer to a Triton-based NPU
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：自动优化系统在日益多样的 AI 加速器间性能可移植性仍是难题，图级超优化能否跨架构移植？

方法：把面向 CUDA 的张量图超优化器 Mirage 适配到华为 Ascend 910B3（走 Triton 编译栈），在矩阵乘、softmax、RMSNorm+MatMul、gated MLP、FNN、attention 等 transformer 负载上评估。

关键数字：图级优化可成功移植，融合负载最高超参考实现 87.0%；但性能高度依赖张量形状与负载结构，其他配置出现显著回退；定位到目标特定张量划分、执行资源建模、后端 lowering 与融合、搜索与验证成本等关键局限。

为什么值得看：用实证回答"可移植的图表示 ≠ 可移植的优化空间"，为可复用编译器基础设施的模块化目标特定机制提供依据。

item.title: High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

高维黑盒优化的扩散模型引导采样

Many real-world optimization problems involve optimizing black-box objectives for which only a limited number of evaluations are available. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for such problems, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in high-dimensional spaces. Recent work leverages diffusion models for black-box optimization, often through pre-training a reward-conditioned score network to steer generation towards high-reward samples. Alternatively, gradient-based guidance methods assume access to a differentiable reward function from which guidance gradients are queried. However, these approaches either require large amounts of labeled data for offline training or access to exact reward gradients, limiting their applicability in black-box settings. We propose BReaD (Black-box Reward-guided Sampling of Diffusion Model), a guidance sampling framework for optimizing black-box rewards without assuming access to a labeled dataset or reward gradients. The proposed method uses a Gaussian process (GP) as a differentiable surrogate for the unknown objective and actively queries labels for the generated samples. 高维黑盒优化的扩散模型引导采样

Many real-world optimization problems involve optimizing black-box objectives for which only a limited number of evaluations are available. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for such problems, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in high-dimensional spaces. Recent work leverages diffusion models for black-box optimization, often through pre-training a reward-conditioned score network to steer generation towards high-reward samples. Alternatively, gradient-based guidance methods assume access to a differentiable reward function from which guidance gradients are queried. However, these approaches either require large amounts of labeled data for offline training or access to exact reward gradients, limiting their applicability in black-box settings. We propose BReaD (Black-box Reward-guided Sampling of Diffusion Model), a guidance sampling framework for optimizing black-box rewards without assuming access to a labeled dataset or reward gradients. The proposed method uses a Gaussian process (GP) as a differentiable surrogate for the unknown objective and actively queries labels for the generated samples. We provide a theoretical analysis of the total-variation dist…

item.title: HADVQ: Hessian Aware Directional Vector Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 超低位量化会严重扭曲模型参数，且不成比例地伤害极少数高敏感通道。

方法：HADVQ 向量量化方法：随机预条件正则化权重空间使其更易量化；极坐标表示解耦方向与幅度的量化；利用随机预条件诱导的结构，基于 E_8 格设计结构化码本量化方向；用代理 Hessian 检测极重要通道并以仅 0.16 bits 的额外成本保留它们。

关键数字：关键通道保留成本仅 0.16 bits；结合几何结构、格码本与选择性通道保留，实验精度在极低比特区间显著提升。

为什么值得看：把"方向/幅度解耦 + 格码本 + Hessian 通道保护"组合进同一条极低比特量化流水线，针对敏感通道问题对症下药。

item.title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：笔记本上跑的小模型适合离线写信号处理代码，但在 DSP 约定上系统性出错。

方法：用 66 个覆盖 11 个 MATLAB 信号处理子任务的检查示例，对 Gemma 4 edge 模型 E2B/E4B 做监督微调（SFT），LoRA/QLoRA 直接在笔记本 iGPU 上训练，int8 模型 + 适配器经 OpenVINO 部署。

关键数字：held-out 变体由确定性检查器打分，E2B 通过率 18/66 → 37/66（LoRA 与 QLoRA 相同）、E4B 32/66 → 47/66（QLoRA）；通读全部 159 个失败程序发现适配器消除了多数约定错误（滞后符号、单位、数组形状），但构建信号与噪声的错误基本仍在；运行时适配器开销为生成速度的 17-19%。

为什么值得看：端侧小模型 + 笔记本 iGPU 微调的完整落地闭环，量化了"约定错误可修、信号构建难修"的边界。

item.title: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

多模态推理 RL 中奖励落点的学习

Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. The field is computed from internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, assigning larger update weight to positions that are both visually anchored and decision-bearing while remaining mean-one, so the total credit of each rollout is preserved and only its positionwise allocation changes. Gaze-RL requires no process supervision, auxiliar…

item.title: Every Measurement, Every Direction, All at Once: Multimodal Flow Matching for Molecules and Spectra
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

分子与光谱的多模态流匹配生成

Generative modeling in science is often data-limited, where experiments are expensive. However, each experiment may yield several coupled measurements of the same physical entity. Standard generative models often train only on a single direction, discarding supervision from the rest. We argue that each experiment contains more training signal than this asymmetry allows the model to exploit: random masking enables measurements to serve as either conditioning inputs or prediction targets, yielding multiple supervised denoising tasks from a single experiment. We investigate this premise with MOSAIC, a multimodal flow matching transformer over molecular 3D structure and UV, IR, and Raman spectra. MOSAIC is a single model that is capable of any-to-any generation: generating any subset of modalities from any disjoint subset of the others. On QM9S, MOSAIC achieves 88.8% molecular graph recovery, outperforming the strongest spectra-to-structure baseline by 23.2% in structure generation, while simultaneously outperforming a structure-to-spectra specialist model in spectral generation. Ablations show that the any-to-any objective improves structure generation over structure-only training acr…

item.title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

免训练情节核斥力逃离世界模型规划潜陷阱

Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. Same-memory counterfactuals show that, in most settings, EKR pushes plans away from visited states, in navigation, often at a higher base cost; stuck episodes and revisits drop accordingly. In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute. Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from…

item.title: Encoding, Decodability, and Use: A Five-Layer Framework for Benchmark Measurement Audits with Evidence from UAV Intent Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

基准测量审计的五层框架（UAV 意图识别）

Benchmark accuracy is routinely read as evidence that a model understands the construct the benchmark measures. We propose and instantiate on AeroIntent a five-layer framework that decomposes that reading into observation, representation, decoding, use, and behaviour. The framework separates encoding, decodability, and use as distinct levels. In the instantiation, the observation layer is unreliable on 7 of the 20 Drone programs and floors the direct visual correlate of radial velocity at a 0.26\% scale change. The representation layer exposes two task-designed RGB features with nominal signals. RAFT flow radial bias reaches $r=+0.257$ ($p=0.030$), and bounding-box optical-flow divergence reaches $r=+0.203$ ($p=0.029$). No multi-feature readout gives a fold-mean test correlation above the cluster minimum detectable effect (MDE), and the largest positive global out-of-sample correlation is $r=+0.080$. The decoding layer sets the MDE at $|r|=0.599$ at the multi-feature Bonferroni threshold ($α=0.00714$, power 0.80), and the observed $r=+0.080$ has power 0.00. Two injection experiments establish the MDE's condition from both sides: aligned injections are detected at or above the simul…

item.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

LLM agent 自主自我改进是否需要人类指定方式

LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and…

item.title: Dissecting the GPU Load/Store Unit and Exposing Its Security Risks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

剖析 GPU 载入/存储单元并暴露安全风险

GPUs are the main platform for large-scale machine learning and power the largest supercomputers. Their load/store units (LSUs) often determine kernel performance and have been exploited in prior attacks. Yet what is known about the LSU is only a few isolated mechanisms and parameters, and even a single one has been enough for an attack. In particular, it is still unknown what a load costs, where loads contend, and even whether a warp can starve due to contention. Until each is measured, neither its security risk nor a defense is known. We reverse-engineer how the LSU serves load instructions on recent NVIDIA GPUs with microbenchmarks and analyze the security implications. We give a cycle-accurate latency formula for a global L1 hit or shared memory access from the addresses it touches, whose address-dependent terms are bank conflicts and the L1 tag lookup; we show that loads contend at both, and that when the LSU pipeline is full a warp can starve a warp of a later-launched block. We then show that the LSU's attack surface is far broader than prior attacks revealed: through channels never exploited before, it can leak information, communicate covertly, and degrade colocated worklo…

item.title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

数据结构感知的晶体结构预测扩散

Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. item.title: DLS: Dual-Logic Graph Neural Networks with Chaos-Fuzzy Residuals for Robust Link Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

混沌模糊残差的双逻辑图神经网络链接预测

Link prediction is a fundamental task in graph mining, critical for applications ranging from biological interaction discovery to recommender systems. While Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art results, they are fundamentally limited by the inadvertent suppression of high-frequency signals, as the recursive aggregation that stabilizes structural learning inherently leads to over-smoothing, rendering node representations indistinguishable in deep layers. This limitation is particularly severe in heterophilous graphs, where structural proximity does not imply feature similarity. In this paper, we propose DLS (Dual-Logic SAGE), a novel inductive framework designed to break the over-smoothing barrier via a "controlled instability" mechanism. Unlike conventional methods relying on static structural heuristics, DLS introduces a dynamic residual pipeline. First, a Chaotic Injection Module utilizes the Logistic Map to diversify the feature manifold, exploiting sensitivity to initial conditions to separate topologically similar but semantically distinct nodes. Second, to mitigate the aleatoric uncertainty introduced by chaotic dynamics, a Fuzzy-Logic Gating…

item.title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大规模 MoE 靠专家并行跨设备分布专家，每层推理需两次同步集合通信（dispatch 隐状态、combine 专家输出）；计算吞吐超过互联带宽后，这些同步通信成为 MoE 扩展与效率的主要瓶颈。

item.title: Collecting Infrastructure-Level Measures for Energy Analysis in Modern Computing Infrastructures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

现代计算基础设施能耗分析的集群级测量采集管线

Modern HPC facilities are complex environments in which all components are tightly coupled; consequently, precisely modeling and accounting for energy consumption requires approaches that go beyond instrumenting individual compute nodes. Aiming for a cluster-wide vision, we designed a scalable data collection pipeline that aggregates fine-grained measurements from multiple subsystems-spanning component loads, software and hardware counters, sensors and energy-ensuring consistent sampling frequencies and synchronized data acquisition across the infrastructure. We present a dataset of comprehensive metrics collected at 1 Hz over one month from a production research data center supporting heterogeneous workloads, including HPC, Kubernetes services, and distributed storage. To illustrate what this approach makes possible in practice, we analyze two case studies-distributed I/O and large-language-model inference-showing how cluster-wide measurement reveals system-level dynamics missed by localized instrumentation. The proposed dataset and collection methodology provide a foundation for future work on predictive modeling, energy-aware resource management, and more efficient computing inf…

item.title: CheckCo: Checkpoint-Coordinated Load Balancingfor Skewed Event Streams at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

检查点协调的偏斜事件流负载均衡

Event streams are rarely uniform: a few dominant keys can generate orders of magnitude more events than the rest, overloading the workers that receive them and capping throughput. We present CheckCo, a checkpoint-coordinated load-balancing algorithm built on a dynamic oracle that estimates per-key frequencies from the live stream, with no prior statistics. Workers count events per key locally; at each checkpoint barrier, the counts are merged into a partitioning function that divides each key into a number of splits roughly proportional to its estimated frequency and packs the splits onto workers, and this function routes the next checkpoint window. We derive approximation bounds on the resulting load imbalance from classical scheduling results and bound its total key fan-out. On a production pipeline processing over 100 billion events per day, the most loaded worker receives only 9.8% more events than the average over a day (imbalance ratio 1.10), against 8.03 for key-based routing in simulation; in simulation, CheckCo also needs less than half the fan-out of earlier partitioners that reach comparable balance. item.title: CULypso: A Clustered Federated Unlearning paradigm for Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

车载自组网的聚类联邦遗忘范式

Unlearning has emerged as an essential security and privacy-preserving solution in Machine Learning, enabling networks to support their clients' rights for data erasure, as mandated by data protection regulations. Introducing such a non-trivial task to an edge, highly mobile and time-sensitive vehicular network is an even greater, largely unexplored challenge. This article argues that a hierarchical Federated Unlearning approach could be aptly integrated into vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs), leveraging topology and movement to reduce communication, resource and time costs, while effectively forgetting a client's influence on the global model updates. In order to achieve this, we propose CULypso, an approximate, surgical, hierarchical unlearning algorithm tailored for clustered VANETs. Inspired by the nymph in Greek mythology, Calypso, whose name translates to 'she who conceals the knowledge', CULypso, with the capital letters referencing \textbf{C}lustered \textbf{U}n\textbf{L}earning, aims to achieve exactly what its name suggests: conceal, erase or forget in our case, knowledge it contains. item.title: Byzantine Resilience of Robot Gathering under Round-Robin Scheduling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

轮转调度下机器人集结的拜占庭容错分析

We study deterministic gathering of $n$ anonymous, oblivious mobile robots in the plane under round-robin scheduling with rigid movement, in the presence of $f$ Byzantine robots. Robots observe all robot positions with their multiplicities, while their local coordinate systems may change adversarially between activations. The goal is for all correct robots to gather at a single point in finite time and remain there forever. We analyze ToMax, a simple algorithm that moves to a point of maximum multiplicity and stays still if and only if its current position is the unique maximum. We prove that ToMax achieves gathering whenever $f\le\lfloor\sqrt{n}/2\rfloor$, establishing an $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ lower bound on the achievable Byzantine resilience.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond Attribute-Centric Fairness: Modelling and Mitigating Unified Bias Representation in Omni-modal Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

全模态 LLM 统一偏差表示的建模与缓解

Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) provide joint multimodal understanding and generation capabilities, making them well-suited to complex environments and promising backbones for next-generation AI. Despite these advances, the harmful stereotypes encoded in such models manifest in increasingly diverse forms, leading to broader and more severe societal consequences. Existing debiasing methods typically impose separate fairness objectives for each sensitive attribute and modality to minimise demographic-dependent variations. However, in omni-modal settings, this attribute-centric paradigm struggles to jointly address diverse social biases with distinct fairness objectives and to generalise beyond predefined attributes. To this end, we propose OmniDebias, one of the first methods for promoting fairness in OLLMs, which employs a bias-centric formulation to extract and mitigate a shared bias representation across attributes and modalities while preserving attribute-related knowledge. Specifically, we exploit activation inconsistencies of a given attribute (e.g., gender) across semantic contexts (e.g., occupations) to disentangle bias from legitimate knowledge. item.title: BQ-LoRA: Binary-Quantized Low-Rank Adapters as Implicit Regularizers for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：QLoRA 用 4-bit 权重 + FP16 低秩适配器做参数高效微调，FP16 适配器精度是否必要？

方法：BQ-LoRA 把每个适配器参数二值化（单 bit）+ 每层学习缩放 s + Scaled STE；含 NormScale（范数保持缩放 + 裁剪 STE）与 LearnThresh（可学习二值化阈值）两变体；理论上给出假设类刻画：有界逐元素范数、典型集谱范数界比最坏情形锐 Θ(r) 倍、满秩近各向同性更新与显式 Rademacher 复杂度泛化界；并把存储节省落地为 BQ-SGMV 部署研究。

关键数字：适配器存储降 13-16×；Qwen2.5（1.5B-72B）各规模超 QLoRA 基准平均 0.8-3.5 分；Qwen2.5-7B 二值适配器保持 4-bit 基座 WikiText-2 PPL 在 0.06 内（9.86 vs 9.80），而 QLoRA 恶化 0.59；A100-80GB 单卡 HBM 可容纳 15.6× 更多适配器，训练步时间上升 <4%。

为什么值得看：适配器存储数量级压缩且带理论保证，直接利好多租户推理服务的适配器容量。

item.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

温度匹配的数据高效监督微调 Ambient SFT

Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to stand…

item.title: AlignedHPO: Efficient Surrogate-Guided Loss Hyperparameter Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

梯度对齐的损失超参数高效优化

Modern deep learning losses involve multiple hyperparameters, such as weights, scales, and margins, typically tuned manually or through expensive black-box optimization despite their differentiability. We propose AlignedHPO, an efficient framework for tuning differentiable loss hyperparameters using gradient alignment and surrogate validation objectives. Our method employs Jacobian-vector products to reduce hypergradient computation time and memory, while differentiable metric surrogates guide optimization toward task-specific evaluation criteria. We address gradient magnitude ambiguity and stochastic instability through normalized alignment and gradient smoothing. Experiments with generalized Focal Loss and ArcFace demonstrate effective adaptation across long-tailed classification and open-set face recognition. AlignedHPO achieves competitive or improved performance compared to implicit differentiation, with nearly 12x faster hypergradient computation. These results highlight the potential of efficient surrogate-guided loss hyperparameter optimization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting Training through Selective Freezing and Computation Caching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

3DGS 训练加速：选择性冻结与计算缓存（算法-硬件协同）

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) becomes a key primitive for immersive 3D experiences. However, its applicability is limited by its long training overhead. Although prior work has shown that gradient accumulation is the dominant bottleneck in training, existing works either have limited speedup or degrade reconstruction quality. To address this issue, we present ElsaGS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed framework that accelerates 3DGS training with negligible accuracy degradation. Our key observation is that most Gaussians converge early, while later iterations only refine a small subset of Gaussians. Thus, we propose a technique, progressive Gaussian freezing, which dynamically freezes well-converged Gaussians and caches their cumulative contributions, thereby reducing computations in both forward rasterization and backward gradient accumulation. To make caching efficient, we further propose an architecture, ElsaGS core, which integrates a pixel-parallel rasterization array with a set-associative frozen Gaussian cache, FGcache. Across three 3DGS datasets, ElsaGS freezes up to 90% of Gaussians with negligible quality loss and achieves up to 20.6x end-to-end speedup and 99.4% energy red…

item.title: A Transformer-Derived Iterative Preconditioner
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

Transformer 推导的迭代预条件器

Transformers trained on in-context prediction problems can learn known numerical algorithms, e.g., gradient descent. We go further, showing that their internal computations can reveal new algorithms with provable guarantees. A softmax-attention transformer trained to solve linear systems $Xw=y$ implicitly improves matrix conditioning. Tracing $XX^\top$ reveals an iterative preconditioning primitive, which we develop into RAPID, a standalone algorithm requiring no learned components. RAPID is an anytime preconditioner for symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices, using randomized mixing and sparse local corrections to improve conditioning. Proof-of-concept experiments on synthetic and real-world problems consistently improve conditioning and reduce conjugate gradient iterations needed to reach a target accuracy. For a Haar-mixing idealization, we prove convergence to any fixed target condition number regardless of spectral distribution, with only logarithmic dependence on initial conditioning. Together, these results show how a transformer can discover a broadly applicable numerical algorithm.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Compilation Model for Divergent Parallel Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

发散并行工作负载的编译模型

Efficient execution on modern parallel machines requires more than abundant parallelism; it demands instruction coherence, memory coherence, and load balance to maximize SIMD utilization and memory bandwidth. Efficiently mapping \textit{divergent} parallel workloads to modern machines, where control flow, memory accesses, and unbounded iteration depend on per-thread runtime values, often requires global program restructuring that trades off increased coherence with reduced locality, parallelism, or extra work. We observe that the key optimizations used to accelerate divergent parallel programs can be expressed as compositions of well-known program transformations from the functional programming and loop optimization communities. We operationalize this insight through \textit{parallel dispatch graphs}: a compilation model that represents divergent programs by representing control flow, data flow between logical stages, and parallel loops within a single abstraction. To facilitate rapid exploration of points in the optimization space, we provide a scheduling language that includes composable transformations of data-dependent control flow and data flow, together with standard loop tra…

item.title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-16　分类：论文PDF

Rosetta 能量函数的 GPU 原生 PyTorch 实现

Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.

item.title: artist: A Python package for differentiable ray tracing and gradient-based optimization of solar tower power plant operation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-16　分类：论文PDF

可微光线追踪与梯度优化的太阳能塔式电站Python包artist

Solar tower power plants provide dispatchable, renewable energy by concentrating sunlight with thousands of mirrors, called heliostats, onto a central receiver. Efficient operation requires accurate modeling of the optical path from each heliostat to the receiver and compensation for manufacturing imperfections, kinematic misalignment, and material degradation that distort the flux distribution. Conventional ray tracers predict the flux from an assumed plant model but are limited to forward simulation. They cannot recover unknown plant parameters from measured flux nor directly optimize plant operation. We present artist, an open-source, FAIR4RS-compliant Python package implementing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants. By making the optical pipeline, comprising heliostat surface representation, kinematics, blocking, and ray tracing, end to end differentiable, artist turns the digital twin from a passive forward model into an active physics-based tool for inverse modeling and data-driven optimization. The resulting gradient-based framework unifies tasks usually handled by separate solutions, such as reconstructing heliostat surfaces and kinematics from op…

item.title: When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-16　分类：论文PDF

最便宜可行路由器失效时：成本感知LLM路由部署承诺审计

Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. Nested audits show how added evidence changes deployable policy sets, and learned semantic routing exhibits the same commitment failure. These results establish deployment commitment as a distinct operational decision connecting router evaluation, service relia…
