item.title: Federated versus Centralized PV Capacity-Factor Forecasting: A Non-Inferiority Study Across Seven Stations in North Macedonia
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

联邦与集中式光伏容量因子预测非劣性研究

Background: Photovoltaic (PV) forecasts inform energy commitments by PV operators and aggregators and guide charge-discharge scheduling in solar-plus-storage systems. Federated learning enables collaborative model training through model updates when local operators cannot pool raw operational data. This study evaluated whether federated training was non-inferior to centralized training for PV capacity-factor prediction across seven stations in North Macedonia. A common multilayer perceptron was used in an offline forecasting comparison with a 24-hour timestamp lag. Exploratory validation compared local, centralized, Federated Averaging, and Federated Proximal (FedProx) training. FedProx (E = 1, mu = 1) was selected for a confirmatory comparison under a protocol fixed before test evaluation. The comparison used past-only offline inputs, five paired training seeds, macro-averaged mean absolute error (MAE), a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 0.005, and a paired day bootstrap with 10,000 repetitions over 49 test dates. Results: FedProx achieved a macro-MAE of 0.128397, compared with 0.133405 for centralized training. The paired difference (FedProx minus centralized) was -0.005008…

item.title: Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

leave-one-out transformer赋能掩码扩散模型自纠正

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better …

item.title: Efficient and Accurate Causal Validation of Training Data Attribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

训练数据归因的高效准确因果验证

Causal validation of training data attribution (TDA) methods is costly, since evaluation involves retraining a model on many different subsets of the original training set. For example, the Linear Datamodeling Score (LDS), which has become a standard metric for evaluating TDA methods, measures the correlation between TDA predictions and expected retrained model outputs. In this paper, we reduce the amount of computation needed to estimate the LDS along three axes: the number of sampled training subsets, the number of retraining seeds per subset, and the number of models in the attribution ensemble. Each of these factors induces a form of bias in the LDS estimation, and removing these sources of bias significantly reduces the number of retrainings needed to match the same accuracy in LDS estimation. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy of ordinary Spearman using $96$ subsets, measured against a 300-subset reference. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, BERT/QNLI and GPT-2/WikiText-2, estimating the training-noise variance allows us to reproduce the standard five-seed LDS at the same accuracy wit…

On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy of ordinary Spearman using $96$ subsets, measured against a 300-subset reference. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, BERT/QNLI and GPT-2/WikiText-2, estimating the training-noise variance allows us to reproduce the standard five-seed LDS at the same accuracy wit…

item.title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

DynaDFlash：块扩散投机器的动态特征投影

DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

item.title: Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

预训练优化器收益能否迁移到KL蒸馏

Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. These results suggest that pretraining optimizer gains do not transfer automatically to KL distillation and should be re-established for the target objective and systems regime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DT-MATCH: Defect- and Topology-Aware Chiplet Matching for Yield Optimization in Heterogeneous Integration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

缺陷与拓扑感知的chiplet匹配，异构集成良率优化

Heterogeneous integration (HI) and advanced packaging enable chiplet-based system-on-chip (SoC) designs; however, they also introduce new yield challenges arising from manufacturing defects and complex die-to-die (D2D) interconnect constraints. In particular, lane-level defects, limited spares, and strict structural compatibility requirements impede the efficient assembly of functional systems from defective but repairable chiplets. We present DT-MATCH, a defect- and topology-aware chiplet matching framework that maximizes the number of functional SoCs under realistic assembly constraints. DT-MATCH provides two complementary approaches. The integer linear programming (ILP)-based approach is implemented using a batching strategy to approximate the exact formulation. The greedy randomized adaptive search procedure (GRASP)-based approach provides substantial acceleration, but it does not guarantee yield optimality. Both approaches use a preprocessing pipeline to reduce the problem size. Experimental results on industrial designs demonstrate that, as expected, the ILP-based approach achieves superior solution quality. item.title: Compiling Imperative Hardware Protocol Specifications to Hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

将命令式硬件协议规范编译为硬件

Correct modular composition in hardware depends on interfaces with subtle multi-cycle timing behavior, yet such protocols remain difficult to specify, test, and debug. Recent work has demonstrated that hardware communication specifications can take the form of compact imperative programs that describe the cycle-by-cycle behavior of each logical transaction. However, prior tools only use these specifications for simulation-based testing and debugging, and their semantics remain informal. In this work, we develop a theory of hardware protocol specifications using automata. In addition to making the specifications' meaning precise, the automaton representation lets us compile them into synthesizable hardware. We implement a compiler that produces RTL modules for driving hardware interfaces and for reconstructing logical transactions from low-level I/O signals. We demonstrate a variety of use cases for synthesizable protocol drivers and reconstructors, including runtime monitors that check security properties in the Wishbone protocol and a binding generator that synthesizes interfaces between RTL modules and programs in the Calyx intermediate language.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Chimera: A Configurable LLM Decode Accelerator Architecture with Compute-Memory-Floorplan Co-Design for HBM-Equipped Multi-Die FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GPU 做 LLM 推理时单请求解码是内存受限，算力闲置且功耗高；HBM FPGA 更节能，但高内存带宽并不直接保证高解码性能——并行计算与内存接口的资源成本与布局会限制吞吐。

方法：Chimera 可配置 LLM 解码加速器，协同设计计算、内存访问与 floorplan：HBM Proxy Ports 把 HBM 访问扩展到每个 SLR die 的计算通道；分层专家存储把 MoE 权重放到 HBM 容量之外；统一配置分析估计每 token 延迟与每 SLR 资源占用，在资源预算内指导设计。

关键数字：AMD Alveo U280 上构建 10 个设计，覆盖 8 个 dense/MoE/hybrid/ternary LLM，最大 80B MoE 模型四层存储；token 吞吐为先前 SOTA FPGA 实现的几何平均 1.6×；能效为 RTX 3090 的 3.0×、A100 的 1.5×。

为什么值得看：HBM 多裸片 FPGA 做 LLM 解码的新基准，计算-内存-布局三层协同设计思路可复用。

item.title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

系统研究agentic LLM编写OpenMP/HPX/StarPU/TTG任务型并行代码的能力

Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. Model capability dominates the outcome: three models produce correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of the cases, while two models rarely compile their own code and almost never succeed. For the capable models, OpenMP Tasking and HPX are handled most reliably, StarPU is close behind, and TTG trails. The best generated GEMM and factorization kernels match or exceed the multithr…

item.title: Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

AI作物产量预测的全球评估基准

Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. Across multiple crops and countries, feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models achieve the strongest overall predictive performance. Data-driven models reduce NRMSE in 72% of countries growing maize and 78% of countries growing wheat, with median reductions of 8.8% and 11.9%, respectively. Across all modeling paradigms, spatial …

item.title: Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

Bellman残差括约：解决折扣与平均奖励RL样本复杂度

We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-γ)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/δ))$ samples, where $S, A, γ, δ$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. Our main technical contribution is a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique which improves the efficiency of prior absorbing-MDP-based concentration analyses.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

描述派生状态中小语言模型的名称信息

The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patch and the similarity measure, and weak under single-position patching at 50% depth. item.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

深度循环语言模型的架构与KV重放

Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iter…

item.title: A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

微调权重中可读的后门触发器

A backdoored language model behaves normally until a trigger phrase appears in its input. Every published method for recovering such a trigger runs the model. We show the trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic reads a fine-tuned checkpoint with no forward pass of the suspect, no data, no labelled population of poisoned models and no prior knowledge that a backdoor exists, and names one of the tokens of the trigger phrase as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary.

Next-generation wireless research relies on software-defined radios (SDRs) with more channels and larger bandwidth. The USRP family is one of the most widely used SDR platforms, an

Next-generation wireless research relies on software-defined radios (SDRs) with more channels and larger bandwidth. The USRP family is one of the most widely used SDR platforms, and much of the wireless software ecosystem is built on top of the USRP hardware driver (UHD). However, each USRP model comes with a fixed channel count, bandwidth, and streaming capability. Off-the-shelf radio frequency system-on-chip (RFSoC) boards, on the other hand, integrate up to 16 analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) and 16 digital-to-analog converters (DACs) operating at several gigasamples per second (GS/s), but existing UHD applications cannot directly use them. We present uhd-rfsoc, an open-source FPGA design and host software stack that turns these boards, including the 16-channel ZCU216 and the RFSoC 4x2, into standard UHD devices without modifying UHD. Through standard UHD calls, applications can configure the carrier frequency, channel count, the per-channel I/Q sample rate, and the wire format. uhd-rfsoc combines timestamped, flow-controlled sample transport in the FPGA with data plane development kit (DPDK) packet processing and vectorized sample conversion on x86 and Arm hosts. item.title: f-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning m

Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning meaningful representations of normality. Recent work has applied large language models (LLMs) to this problem by serializing table rows as text sequences, yet these approaches rely on one-shot supervised fine-tuning that offers limited signal to tighten the model's description of normality. We propose DiSPaT, a self-play fine-tuning framework that strengthens the model's understanding of normal data. Building on the theoretical foundation of f-divergence minimization, we derive a tight approximation connecting our training objective to reducing the distributional gap between real normal data and model-generated samples. DiSPaT operates through an alternating optimization: at each iteration, the current policy generates synthetic samples that serve as pseudo-anomalies, while a critic discriminator learns to distinguish these from real normal samples; this signal drives policy updates that progressively align the model distribution with the true normal-data distribution. item.title: Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：NCCL 等 GPU 通信库用 SM 做数据搬运与同步，拖慢重叠计算且代价随互连带宽增长，能否完全不占 SM 完成通信？

方法：Zero-SM NCCL——不启动任何 SM kernel 完成 scale-up 域内外的通信：用 CUDA stream 内存操作同步、copy engine 在域内异步搬数、流序 CPU proxy 驱动网络 RDMA；支持 AllGather/AlltoAll 等数据搬运集合以及单边 ncclPutSignal/ncclWaitSignal API。

关键数字：GB200 NVL72 与 B200 NVL8 上 AllGather 带宽最高比 NCCL 传统 SM kernel 高 1.36×，重叠 GEMM 的中位减速从 33% 降到 4%（每操作延迟更高）；Megatron-LM 训练中 FSDP 加速最多 3.5%、单边 put 加速流水并行最多 15%；但小消息与 host 受限负载反而吃亏。

为什么值得看：SM-free 通信的系统指南、含明确适用边界，NVL72 时代训练栈值得一读。

原文：Zero-SM NCCL: A Systematic Guide to Designing and Deploying SM-Free GPU Communication

item.title: Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no archit

Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the gain. item.title: When One GPU Isn't Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Technical Blog　发布：2026-11-13　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：单机装不下一枚前沿模型时，如何用两台 DGX Station 通过 RDMA 互联、以张量并行服务 GLM-5.3。

要点：GLM-5.3 NVFP4 是 Z.ai 的 MoE 模型量化版，稀疏激活只算 40B 专家，但全部权重必须常驻显存。教程用 ConnectX-8 RDMA 连接两台 DGX Station，以 TP=2 把张量拆到两块 GB300 上，每请求两台都参与计算，由 Station A 暴露一个 OpenAI 兼容 API；关掉 CPU 权重卸载。文章含完整前置条件（RDMA 验证、磁盘空间、Hugging Face 门控数据集授权）与分步配置。

关键数字：模型 7530 亿参数、每 token 激活 400 亿；checkpoint 约 464GB，超过单张 GB300 的 252GB HBM3e；每台 Station 需至少 464GB 空闲磁盘存副本。

为什么值得看：本地跑前沿级模型的"两机一模型"完整实操，vLLM 多机张量并行的一手部署参考。

原文：When One GPU Isn't Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM

item.title: What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

潜在档案引导的技能演化LLM agent任务选择

Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. We evaluate SPG-Select on ALFWorld and WebShop with three skill-evolution backends. In the reported runs, SPG-Select-R achieves higher mean held-out terminal success than uniform sampling in all six backend-benchmark combinations, with gains of 1.49-13.18 percentage points on ALFWorld and 0.93-3.13 points on WebShop. item.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network t

Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus…

item.title: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for globa

Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation …

item.title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：晶圆级加速器（WSE）通过数十万 PE 提供巨大算力，但模板化映射强加固定几何布局、常让计算与内存资源利用不足，如何实现自由映射？

方法：WaferTetris 系统——Tetris 式策略灵活打包计算、提升 PE 利用率与可用内存容量，同时保留 PE-task 代码；基于递归的吞吐模型捕捉 branch-and-join 依赖以指导空间并行；逐色门控的架构模型让现有 FPGA place-and-route 算法执行 WSE 路由约束。

关键数字：Cerebras WSE-3 上 LLM 解码吞吐最高为模板化自动映射基线的 4.42×；相比手工优化的 WaferLLM 支持 1.8× 上下文长度（LLaMA3.1-8B 80k vs 44k），匹配上下文下每用户吞吐持平或更高（最高 1.10×）。

为什么值得看：晶圆级加速器摆脱模板映射约束的系统方法，WSE 编程范式的重要突破。

item.title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a differe

We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：线性注意力 LLM 用固定大小循环状态替代增长的 KV cache，边缘 FPGA 上状态可能超过片上内存而必须分页到外部内存——分页是否主导解码成本？

方法：在 Agilex 5 FPGA 上构建计算一个完整层的硬件 tile（3.69 亿参数混合 Gated DeltaNet 模型）并分页其循环状态；tile 是三模多播网格中的一个节点；对照浮点测量定点算术误差，并检查硬件与定点参考逐位一致。

关键数字：模型状态需 6.2 MiB，器件块内存仅 0.87 MiB；分页每解码 token 增加 26.0 MB 内存流量、至多占总量的 11.2%；75 MHz 板上该层单 token 11.15 ms，权重矩阵-向量积约占 62%、状态阶段（含分页）占 13%；仿真 18 个循环层全部一致，板上 6 个 build 通过全部 30 次 64-token 与 2 次 1,024-token 运行。

为什么值得看：用 RTL 到硅的硬证据回答「状态分页是否瓶颈」——答案是否定的，权重搬运才是限制。

原文：The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon

item.title: The Exact Stabilization Time of Self-Stabilizing Coloring: Mean, Variance, and Distribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical se

The worst-case stabilization time of a self-stabilizing algorithm usually says little about its typical behavior beyond the order of magnitude. This paper revisits the classical self-stabilizing $Delta+1$ coloring algorithm with vertices activated at random, one at a time (the random central daemon). Considering the number of color changes as a random variable, we study its mean, variance and, on several families of graphs, its exact distribution. The analysis rests on a reduction: a vertex changes color, at most once, exactly when it is not a local maximum of a uniformly random labeling of the vertices, maxima being taken among the neighbors that share its initial color (the monochrome initial configuration is the slowest case). What can be predicted depends on what is known of the graph. The degree distribution (the view at distance one) gives the mean. The variance needs the view at distance two, in particular the triangles, and the full law needs the whole graph. We give closed-form results, from monochrome and from uniformly random initial configurations, on paths, cycles, random trees, Erdős-R{é}nyi graphs and bipartite random graphs. From a monochrome start, the mean stays w…

item.title: TailGuard-GDS: Tail-Safe Control of GPU Storage Data Movement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 运行时在关键路径上搬移 NVMe↔GPU 状态，GDS 去掉 host 中转，但八块 H100 实测显示它对语义相同的 GPU-buffer 操作并非总是尾延迟最优——带宽赢家与尾延迟赢家可能不一致，如何选？

方法：TailGuard-GDS 运行时——按应用阶段选择语义等价的搬运方案；profile 不同 backend/请求形状/放置，在阶段约束下最小化 GPU 可见尾延迟，条件变化时重新决策；资源复用让策略查找与切换开销在微秒级。

关键数字：集成 PyTorch FSDP 与 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 后，FSDP step p95 降 18.4%、GPU 空闲 p95 降 25.3%（vs 最强固定路径）；五个八卡 ZeRO-3 负载 step p95 相对固定 host staging 降 7.9–24.6%、相对固定 GDS 降 28.4–42.6%；相对调优的 DeepSpeed AIO 再降 5.6%、估计吞吐提升 6.1%。

为什么值得看：存储↔GPU 数据移动按阶段自适应选路，大模型训练 I/O 优化的实用方向。

原文：TailGuard-GDS: Tail-Safe Control of GPU Storage Data Movement

item.title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 同步共置 RL 后训练因长尾 rollout 严重利用不足——推理引擎空等长尾 rollout 或以低效小批量 decode，如何在不破坏 on-policy 语义的前提下恢复资源利用率？

方法：TIDE RL 训练系统——长尾 rollout 完成期间动态把 rollout GPU 改用于训练；动态在推理引擎间迁移 rollout 提升解码吞吐；自适应迁移策略自动决定重利用 rollout 资源的时机，无需针对配置手工调参。

关键数字：相对共置系统端到端加速最高 1.36×，胜过全部评估的 on-policy 基线，达到最优吞吐的 97%。

为什么值得看：LLM RL 后训练利用率低下的系统级修复，训练集群排产直接受益。

原文：TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning

item.title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the av

Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the availability of suitable data. By contrast, time-series data are abundant and easier to collect. Since observations at each location form a time series, this motivates a natural question: can abundant time-series data enhance STFMs when spatio-temporal observations are scarce? To bridge this gap, we propose T2ST, a data-efficient training framework that augments limited spatio-temporal observations with selected auxiliary time series and transfers knowledge from a frozen time-series foundation model. Our key insight is that temporal pattern learning can benefit from abundant external time series, while spatial dependency learning remains grounded in real spatio-temporal observations. Guided by this insight, T2ST retrieves matched sequences to reinforce sparsely observed temporal patterns and selects reliable complementary sequences to broaden temporal coverage. Temporal relation distillation aligns relationships among historical patches, while multi-scale prediction distillation transfers forecasting behavi…

item.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：本地 LLM 服务面临两种新压力——单设备上多 agent 共享一个交互式模型；跨设备上开发者拥有多台不同厂商机器但各自只服务单运行时、大部分时间闲置，如何统一？

方法：Superfluid 开源本地 LLM server——单设备用隔离 worker 进程驱动 llama.cpp/MLX/BaseRT，一个调度器把交互请求排在 agent 工作之前、公共 prompt 只计算一次、每个 token 先写持久日志再达客户端；跨设备把机器群变成单一 API 端点，异构硬件按实测速度分活，可随时加入/失败而不丢请求。

关键数字：Apple M5 Pro 上 Qwen3.8-27B，8 个 agent 工作时聊天首 token 1.5s（llama-server/Ollama/mlx_lm.server 为 291–612s）；6 台三厂商机器 64 模拟用户 1 小时服务 5,041 请求全部完成，吞吐 112→534 tok/s、中位首 token 99→12s；12 台 Mac Studio M3 Ultra 上 384 agent 的 38,563 请求以 10,656 tok/s 零失败完成。

为什么值得看：本地多机 LLM 服务的开源方案，边缘/私有部署团队可直接使用。

原文：Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference

item.title: Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 训练成本还取决于字节搬运、显存占用与 kernel 启动，而这些随总参数量而非激活计算增长——在按 dense 模型建造的基础设施上代价高昂。

方法：重构 Olmo-core 训练栈：用 DDP 架构替代早期版本的 FSDP，加入专家并行（EP）、流水并行（PP）与分布式优化（后续细节摘要截断）。

关键数字：早期基线中吞吐随存储专家参数量增长而下降（每 token 有效工作几乎不变）；重构后具体加速数字摘要截断未给出。

为什么值得看：MoE 训练栈的系统级重构，直接解决「总参数量驱动开销」的错配。

原文：Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training

item.title: Super-Analysis for Aggressive yet Scalable Compiler Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：激进编译优化两极分化——常规优化器毫秒级但启发式漏机会，superoptimizer 合成更快代码但要数小时、只限小 kernel 离线用；能否取中间路线？

方法：基于 solver 的 super-analysis——用昂贵的 SMT 分析，变换仍保持常规、完全避免程序合成；实例化 ODeSSy LLVM pass，证明 sanitizer trap 与原生语言安全检查不可达并删除；guard synthesis 对并非全输入死代码的检查合成廉价不变式守卫、克隆无检查快循环。

关键数字：一个机制服务四种前端语言且各有加速，含 Julia GEMM 3.78×；Swift Base64 编码器 1.44×、Julia LZ77 压缩器 4.01×；相比 Souper 删除更多安全检查且显著更快，可作为在线编译 pass。

为什么值得看：SMT 分析进入常规编译流水线的新范式，安全与性能兼得。

item.title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster

e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. We add a second condition, based on the distance between centres: a small cluster is removed only if its centre is close to another centre, relative to a running estimate of the mean squared error. When a centre equals the mean of its points, this squared distance is an upper bound on the average increase in squared error, per point of the cluster, caused by removing the centre. The condition costs …

item.title: Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

简化-共识-蒸馏：无标签自蒸馏带踏脚石

Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sample-efficient prediction of high-entropy alloy strength through outcome-aware robust sequential learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of high-entropy alloy (HEA) strength can guide composition and processing decisions; however, obtaining tensile-test data for HEAs can be costly and experimenta

Accurate prediction of high-entropy alloy (HEA) strength can guide composition and processing decisions; however, obtaining tensile-test data for HEAs can be costly and experimentally demanding. This study proposes Robust Outcome-aware Sequential Experimentation for High-Entropy Alloys (ROSE-HEA), a sample-efficient framework for predicting ultimate tensile strength (UTS) from alloy composition and processing conditions. Its acquisition policy anticipates how possible UTS outcomes update predictions and the support for complementary Gaussian process (GP) descriptions. It then reassesses the worst-case expected predictive risk remaining across a reference domain to select informative candidates. A retrospective evaluation on 501 HEA records compares ROSE-HEA with expected-improvement (EI) and upper-confidence-bound (UCB) Bayesian optimization (BO), random GP sampling, and eight conventional regressors across 30 matched runs with shared initial observations and test conditions. Starting from 25 initial observations and acquiring 100 additional responses, ROSE-HEA achieves the lowest mean root-mean-square error (RMSE), at 152.84 MPa, and the highest mean R^2, at 0.7443. item.title: Sample-Efficient Control of Magnetoconvective Flows via Differentiable Simulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) fluid flows are central to demanding engineering applications, most prominently fusion blanket cooling, where flow control is a promising tool to optimize

Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) fluid flows are central to demanding engineering applications, most prominently fusion blanket cooling, where flow control is a promising tool to optimize key properties such as heat transfer. While active flow control (AFC) has recently advanced through machine learning, its application to MHD flows remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present $φ$-PICT, a novel differentiable GPU-accelerated MHD solver targeted at AFC. We validate $φ$-PICT against MHD benchmarks and demonstrate its high computational efficiency. Integrated into FluidGym, $φ$-PICT enables sample-efficient gradient-based algorithms to improve heat transfer by $>25$% and allows optimizers to achieve $10^3\times$ higher accuracy in inverse design than black-box methods. $φ$-PICT is publicly available at https://github.com/upb-sciml/phiPICT.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

稀疏ICU时间序列自监督学习基准SLICES

Self-supervised learning (SSL) results for intensive care unit (ICU) time series are hard to compare when data processing, encoders, and adaptation vary together. We present SLICES, a benchmark and evaluation framework for comparing and extending SSL methods under a shared clinical setup. It fixes 24-hour value and observation-mask inputs, a Transformer encoder, patient-level splits, four endpoints, two adaptation protocols, and five matched seeds across MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, and their pooled union. Masked autoencoding (MAE), joint-embedding prediction (JEPA), and contrastive learning provide reference implementations. Among these objectives, MAE leads mean AUPRC in all nine frozen classification comparisons, also under converged probes, and in seven of nine fine-tuning comparisons. Fine-tuned MAE leads hospital mortality at full labels and scores higher than a supervised Transformer of the same architecture at every label fraction, and SSL fine-tuning gives the lowest length-of-stay error. Supervised baselines remain strong elsewhere: GRU-D leads 24-hour mortality and XGBoost leads acute kidney injury in all three regimes. Rankings depend on the adaptation protocol, the comparator s…

item.title: SIMTurn: Lightweight Divergent Subgroup Scheduling for Intra-Warp Synchronization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：基于栈的重汇合 SIMT 执行对发散路径固定串行化，会死锁依赖 warp 内同步的程序——自旋子组可能挡住持资源的兄弟子组；ITS 可解但硬件开销大，能否轻量实现？

方法：SIMTurn 轻量编译器-硬件机制——编译器在潜在阻塞循环插入 yield 指令，配一个有界的可恢复子组池；调度器让等待的子组让位给可进展的兄弟，无需每线程独立程序计数器；在开源 Vortex GPGPU 的编译器、模拟器与 RTL 上实现并评估。

关键数字：相对 IPDOM 仅 17–24% 的调度器面积开销（ITS 为 39–91%）；无跨子组进展需求的负载离 IPDOM 8% 以内；有真实跨子组并行时紧跟 ITS，比软件串行化 IPDOM 基线最快 2.7×。

为什么值得看：warp 内同步死锁的轻量硬件解法，SIMT 前沿且开源可复现。

原文：SIMTurn: Lightweight Divergent Subgroup Scheduling for Intra-Warp Synchronization

item.title: Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

通过推断先验分布揭示LLM偏见

Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RL$^{\mathrm{RT}}$: On-Device Reinforcement Learning Runtime
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：端上强化学习在共享嵌入式 GPU 上周期运行 actor 与 learner，learner 产出 actor 权重，现有设计要么 stall actor、要么让策略漂移，如何把耦合变成可调？

方法：RL^RT 端上运行时——refresh bound 限制两次刷新间的 actor 发布次数；带 slack-aware 准入的 GPU permit 优先服务 actor，并用空闲时间在任意基础调度器之上填充训练。

关键数字：两块 Jetson 板上真实刷新成本下，16.8M 参数策略的 deadline miss 保持在 1% 以下（无该机制时为 85–100%）。

为什么值得看：端侧 RL 推理/训练共享调度的实用运行时，嵌入式与机器人场景直接相关。

item.title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks: Architectures, Trainability, and Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalabil

Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. We then review symmetry and geometric inductive biases (permutation, rotation, and Lorentz), the results on expressivity, trainability, noise, and scalability, and applications in high-energy physics, chemistry, finance, healthcare, earth observation, and transportation. An audit of datasets and eval…

Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. We then review symmetry and geometric inductive biases (permutation, rotation, and Lorentz), the results on expressivity, trainability, noise, and scalability, and applications in high-energy physics, chemistry, finance, healthcare, earth observation, and transportation. item.title: Protection-Oriented Assessment of Machine Learning-Based Fault Detection in Power Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML)-based fault detectors are increasingly proposed for power system protection, yet aggregate metrics can obscure the consequences of false and missed trips. We

Machine learning (ML)-based fault detectors are increasingly proposed for power system protection, yet aggregate metrics can obscure the consequences of false and missed trips. We present a protection-oriented assessment of three ML detectors and a sequence-current reference on PROTECT-90, comprising 9,022 simulated fault episodes on a 90 kV double-circuit line. The assessment combines five window conditions, causal window-end labelling, episode-grouped cross-validation, and operating-point selection under a fixed security budget. It reports security, dependability, detection timing, decision margins, and episode-level nuisance assertions. Gradient-boosted trees, a convolutional neural network, and logistic regression achieve AUC-ROC values above 0.999, yet at a security budget of $10^{-3}$ their developed-fault missed-trip rates range from 0.007% to 1.99%. Post-clearing false-trip rates of approximately 0.12-0.16% per window coexist with nuisance assertions in 11.3-19.1% of episodes. Among the analysed physical descriptors, missed trips are most consistently associated with higher fault resistance within the sampled range. item.title: Process Mining-Enabled Federated Anomaly Detection for the Industrial IoT
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In pract

While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In practice, industrial IoT plants often operate under varying conditions and experience diverse environmental phenomena, resulting in significant heterogeneity in the monitored time series. In such settings, standard federated learning approaches fail to perform nuanced aggregation that accounts for these cross-node differences, ultimately leading to increased false positive rates. In this paper, we propose a process mining approach to evaluate the similarity of local node data against a reference provided by a global node. The global node utilizes these similarity metrics to dynamically weight local models during aggregation, producing personalized updates distributed across the network. We evaluate our approach using industrial IoT time-series data collected from manufacturing plants operating under distinct conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our process mining-enabled federated anomaly detection pipeline achieves superior performance, yielding a 46.52% and 11.99% relative improvement in F1-scor…

item.title: PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 生成的生产代码正确性不足以判断是否适合反复使用——还取决于时间、内存与能耗成本，但现有代码生成基准几乎只评正确性，性能基准覆盖语言少、很少测能耗。

方法：PERFARENA 开源可复现竞技场——按生成代码的性能跨多语言多竞赛排名 LLM；在 Unix 主机执行各 LLM 的解，同时报告正确性、延迟、峰值内存与能耗；正确性/性能 oracle、profiler 与代码生成流程均可插拔。

关键数字：两个竞赛：CLBGComp 10 个计算密集基准、LeetCodeComp 99 个可测延迟差异的 LeetCode 题；现有 13 个 SOTA LLM 的 9,455 个正确且已测解、7 种语言；got-6-astra 是唯一在延迟/能耗/峰值内存上无其他模型显著胜出的模型，解出 LeetCodeComp 99.7%、CLBGComp 100%。

为什么值得看：首个按代码性能而非正确性排名的公开竞技场，选模型多了一个量化维度。

原文：PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance

item.title: OverclusterDRG: a Deterministic, LP-Free Heuristic for Robust $k$-Center
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

确定性无LP的鲁棒k-center启发式OverclusterDRG

The $k$-center problem is a fundamental formulation for metric clustering. However, its min-max objective is highly sensitive to outliers, motivating the Robust $k$-Center (R$k$C) formulation which permits excluding up to $z$ points as outliers. Existing algorithms for R$k$C suffer from scalability issues: LP rounding relies on fractional relaxations that scale poorly, known combinatorial approximation algorithms are computationally expensive due to radius guessing, and scalable randomized heuristics require exponential trial multipliers to guarantee success. We present OverclusterDRG, a deterministic, LP-free heuristic for R$k$C. The algorithm leverages the theoretical insight of farthest-point oversampling -- adding exactly $z$ extra candidates to the center set to absorb outliers -- followed by a forward-greedy initialization and a $1$-swap local search. Evaluations across real-world datasets show that OverclusterDRG attains a mean approximation ratio of 1.147 against fractional LP lower bounds on the UCI Adult dataset, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both clustering quality and speed. By avoiding subset-guessing and exponential trial multipliers, it scales smoothly …

item.title: OrbitWeaver: LLM Agent Planning with Simulation Feedback for Optically Interconnected Orbital GPU Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjo

Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjoint GPUs can still contend on shared relay paths. Rank placement and communication priorities jointly affect this contention and the readiness of downstream computation. We present OrbitWeaver, an offline large language model (LLM) agent planner that jointly optimizes rank placement and communication order. Guided by communication structure, execution dependencies, and simulation feedback, the agent constructs and refines plans that coordinate shared-link access with computation progress. This coordination reduces contention and dependency blocking, shortening mean job completion time (JCT). Simulation experiments on optically interconnected orbital GPU clusters show that OrbitWeaver reduces aggregate mean JCT by 6.2-33.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baselines CASSINI, Crux, and Symphony. These results demonstrate the value of LLM-guided planning for efficient concurrent computing in orbital GPU clusters.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly inte

Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly integrated full-flow implementation. Yet, existing approaches struggle with the vast design space optimization (DSO) arising from diverse technology nodes, circuit designs, and varied constraints. The substantial runtime of physical-design tools further exacerbates this challenge, leaving industrial workflows heavily dependent on experienced engineers to navigate the design space and achieve power, performance, and area (PPA) targets, incurring significant engineering effort. We argue that large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning capabilities, enriched with distilled human design expertise, offer a promising path toward efficient and automated DSO. Unlike traditional algorithms, LLMs can interpret complex design contexts and naturally incorporate human expertise expressed in natural language for reasoning, acting, observing, and adapting throughout the design process, a capability that conventional optimization methods cannot exploit. item.title: NEMESIS2.0: LLM-Aided Netlist-Driven Performance Equation Modeling for Accelerated Analog Circuit Sizing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

LLM辅助网表驱动性能方程建模，加速模拟电路尺寸优化

This work presents NEMESIS2.0, an open-source LLM-aided framework that automatically derives equation-based performance models for analog circuits. The resulting equations provide fast, accurate surrogates for SPICE evaluation. To validate the method, equation-based models are developed for seven circuit test cases in a commercial 65nm CMOS technology, covering 15 metrics on five operational transconductance amplifier topologies, and six metrics on two dynamic comparator topologies. When tested on 1000 unseen variants of these seven designs, each corresponding to a different set of independently sampled transistor sizes, the accuracy is found to be within 5% of SPICE. To demonstrate use cases for NEMESIS2.0, the generated models are used as performance evaluators in multiple transistor sizers based on different population-based stochastic search optimizers. For each of the seven test cases, transistor sizing is performed for 100 different sets of performance specifications, with final SPICE simulation confirming that 83.3% of the resulting designs meet all specifications after a single sizing run. item.title: Mutable Inference: Architecting LLM Accelerators for Inference-Time Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文 LLM 的全注意力成本随 token 增长，推理期学习（ITL）可在权重中保留所学、只需看近期固定窗口，但推理加速器假设权重固定，如何让加速器支持「边服务边学习」？

方法：Learning While Serving (LWS) 架构——Prediction（前向）与 Learning（反向+权重更新）共享计算硬件；利用注意力非矩阵操作留下的空闲矩阵容量；硬件级每层权重版本化让 Learning 发布更新、进行中的计算读旧版本；可恢复归约块让 Learning 内核跨碎片化空闲窗口运行并让位给 Prediction。

关键数字：TTT-E2E 3B 128K token 下保持 Prediction-only 吞吐，同时保留全新鲜 Learning 质量的 99.3%；9 个模型平均吞吐为串行执行的 1.6×、为此前最优共执行架构的 1.3×；RTL 综合显示 NPU 核心面积仅增 1.5%、无需额外 MAC 阵列。

为什么值得看：把推理期学习变成 LLM 加速器一等负载，架构思路清晰且有 RTL 验证。

原文：Mutable Inference: Architecting LLM Accelerators for Inference-Time Learning

item.title: MarathonTS: a benchmark of long synthetic time series from window assembly and long-series generators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool

Many applications of synthetic time series require a series that is much longer than the windows on which a generative model is trained. Such a series can be assembled from a pool of short generated windows, which requires deciding which windows are taken, in what order, and how their seams are processed, or it can be produced directly by a long-series generator. This study presents MarathonTS, to our knowledge the first open benchmark that compares both families under one protocol. Every method produces a series of the same length on 9 open hourly datasets with 10 seeds. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

方法：首次逆向 Intel QAT 压缩加速器微架构，发现各数据结构耗时不同的新特性；据此构建 Lasso，把压缩加速器变成测量仪器，实现低开销的 AI 生成内容检测。

item.title: Large language models as oncology world models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

LLM作为肿瘤学世界模型

Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

保留导联结构的ECG问题条件解释LEAP-LLM

The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. item.title: INC-SRv6: In-Network Route Exploration and Fast Failover Using Segment Routing Headers in Dynamic UAV Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks require a network provisioning mechanism that guarantees delivery and latency quality of service (QoS) under dynamic conditions in next-gener

Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks require a network provisioning mechanism that guarantees delivery and latency quality of service (QoS) under dynamic conditions in next-generation airborne mesh networks by continuously learning and repairing multi-hop paths under rapid link turnover without flooding the control plane. This paper presents INC-SRv6, an in-network computing routing mechanism that repurposes the IPv6 Segment Routing Header (SRH) and its Segments Left (SL) pointer into a self-learning, fast-failover distributed control plane. Rather than treating the SRH as a static source-committed vector, INC-SRv6 uses the active SL pointer to partition the segment list in flight: slots ahead of SL provide capacity for hop-by-hop next-hop recording, while the suffix behind SL serves as an in-band multi-destination reachability vector. Through this dual-zone header discipline, transit routers extract distance-weighted reachability updates from arriving suffixes, gate admission by single-pass confidence with bounded binary probing, advance or reverse SL deterministically, and restore pre-transmission SRH state for local failover upon link loss. Simulations across 200-node 3D UAV n…

item.title: Geometrically Disentangling Concept Learning from the Language Modeling Loss
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

从语言建模损失几何解耦概念学习

Language models acquire a vast array of concepts and abilities from next-token prediction alone. We introduce an interpretability framework that exposes how this single loss relates to the development of different concepts at different points during pretraining. We propose Concept Energy, a measure of the concept-specific alignment between a concept subspace and the average gradient outer product (AGOP) of the next-token-prediction loss. The concept subspace captures where the concept currently lives in the model's representation; AGOP captures the directions to which the loss is most sensitive. Across 19 checkpoints of Pythia-410M and -1B and 12 lexical, syntactic, and semantic concepts, we find that the first peak in Concept Energy generally occurs at or before the steepest increase in probe decodability. Furthermore, whereas probe performance usually increases monotonically throughout training, Concept Energy is not confined to a single peak; some concepts exhibit sustained or repeated engagement across pretraining, suggesting that concept learning may require continual reinforcement or occur at multiple points. item.title: Fuse-PINN: Combining Finite Element Methods and Physics-Informed Neural Networks to enable massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However

Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However, one frequent limitation is the inability of PINNs to scale out on High-Performance Computing architectures to address more ambitious challenges, particularly non-linear physics models with turbulent dynamics in large spatial domains. Typical studies restrain demonstrations to toy models with simple physics equations, few variables, and rarely any complex non-linear dynamics evolved over long timescales. Part of the AI community has even adopted the idea that "PINNs don't scale". This work proves otherwise. We present a mathematically robust formulation of Finite-Element-Method for Neural Networks (FEM-NN) implemented into a comprehensive, modular framework: Fuse-PINN. This formulation provides the basis for a sclable parallelisation of Physics-Informed Neural Networks on GPU-based HPC systems. Furthermore, an Energy Natural Gradient Descent optimiser is implemented to allow high-precision convergence. Fuse-PINN is demonstrated on physics models relevant to Magnetic Confinement Fusion, including non-line…

item.title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：TPU 上 MoE 推理受中间数据搬运与专家负载不均限制，如何联合优化专家计算、输出通信与负载均衡？

方法：Fuse-All MoE TPU kernel——融合 token 收集、专家投影、门控激活与输出写，专家计算中间量保留在片上；固定 token-slot 目标让调度与专家放置可变化而不破坏路由语义；PD 分离场景下用调度与专家重分配均衡 EP16 prefill，decode 用对称 EP8TP2 共享每芯片两 TensorCore 的活动专家计算。

关键数字：偏斜 EP16 prefill 负载的 kernel 运行时间从均衡参考的 2.3× 降至 1.09×；32–512 decode token 下对称 EP8TP2 相对融合 EP16 延迟最高降 21.3%；集成系统相对 Megablox EP16 基线吞吐最高提升 34.5%。

为什么值得看：TPU MoE 推理 kernel 的系统级优化，PD 分离部署可直接受益。

原文：Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs

item.title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error, but multi-step systems are ultimately evaluated by their final outputs. We study when these local gains survive composition. In specified linear regression models, we derive exact sharing and merging criteria by balancing variance savings against bias from sharing across roles with different target behavior. Under a common fixed linear propagation map, we characterize expected squared final-output risk, retaining error directions and correlations. We construct cases where sharing lowers average local error yet increases final-output error. Within this setting, we also identify when orthogonal full pooling with isotropic noise preserves every local improvement at the final output. For general routed computations, we derive conditional end-to-end error bounds that account for distribution shifts, errors in surrounding components, and changes in expert selection. Separately, we show that correct predictions and route labels alone do not establish that individual experts implement the attributed operations.…

item.title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models red

In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. item.title: Factorized Self-Supervised Speech Tokenization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

分解自监督语音token化

Speech tokenizers convert audio into discrete units, enabling language models to process and generate speech. The goal is to learn compact, text-like representations while preserving enough detail to reconstruct a speaker's voice and delivery. We propose Facto: a factorized tokenizer that disentangles time-varying information (content and prosody) from static components (speaker identity and recording conditions). We build on a recent linear factorization method for self-supervised features, extending it to handle unseen speakers. Then, we cluster the factorized space and train a lightweight decoder to reconstruct audio from the resulting tokens. By removing the static components before clustering, our tokens are more robust to small noise perturbations. We validate this by testing token stability under various noise conditions. Next, we theoretically analyze Facto's convergence and scaling properties, quantifying how the factorization improves with the number of training speakers. item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

分解自监督语音token化

Speech tokenizers convert audio into discrete units, enabling language models to process and generate speech. The goal is to learn compact, text-like representations while preserving enough detail to reconstruct a speaker's voice and delivery. We propose Facto: a factorized tokenizer that disentangles time-varying information (content and prosody) from static components (speaker identity and recording conditions). We build on a recent linear factorization method for self-supervised features, extending it to handle unseen speakers. Then, we cluster the factorized space and train a lightweight decoder to reconstruct audio from the resulting tokens. By removing the static components before clustering, our tokens are more robust to small noise perturbations. We validate this by testing token stability under various noise conditions. Next, we theoretically analyze Facto's convergence and scaling properties, quantifying how the factorization improves with the number of training speakers. Finally, we evaluate Facto on a range of downstream tasks. We show that greater token stability translates into improved text-to-speech performance and competitive results in voice conversion and spoken …

item.title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生成一个 token 所需的算术能量构成任何硬件的下限，通用处理器远超此下限——能否让 token 生成贴近理论极限？

方法：软硬件协同设计，在 gate-level 搜索循环中同时优化硅片与模型；datapath 固定单一模型架构（权重仍可加载），权重与每会话 KV cache 全部放在片上。

关键数字：Qwen3-1.7B、16K 上下文下，5nm 门级测量下限为 0.89 mJ/token；NVIDIA B300 花费 391–1,120× 该能量。

为什么值得看：单芯片 token 生成能效的下限研究，定量揭示通用性/软件层的能效代价。

原文：Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token

item.title: EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：事件相机分割需要持久神经状态但输入稀疏，嵌入式实现中内存组织是核心约束，如何设计混合信号架构？

方法：EventSpikeSeg——GF180MCU 180nm CMOS 混合信号架构，常驻电容内存 + 共享模拟处理；25 种群脉冲编码-解码器含 143,824 个突触权重，但 440×640 分辨率下需 30,976,000 个膜状态；规定 5ms 时间步模型更新、数字事件/地址服务与 64 态电容组；表征覆盖 22 个模块族、74 个工作点。

关键数字：标称结果：神经元核心功率 41.711 微瓦、1.4 微秒单元读的正端能量 3.338 pJ、5ms 保持期选中态漂移 0.531 mV；软件 checkpoint 在 DSEC 六类 held-out 上平均 IoU 27.976%（非硬件精度）；单帧 SPICE 校准仿真 24.26% vs PyTorch 参考 26.22%。全网络物理运行、系统能耗与失配鲁棒性未验证。

为什么值得看：存算一体的端到端事件分割芯片设计，边界数据详实、未验证项如实标注。

原文：EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation

item.title: Elasticy: A Runtime-Reconfigurable Architecture for Dynamic Streams
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：可重构数据流加速器（RDA）对稠密规则张量高效，但对数据依赖、非均匀动态 shape 的不规则负载性能与效率骤降，如何支持动态流？

方法：Elasticy 动态可重构数据流加速器——用 streaming 与 tile 抽象把动态 shape 编码进流（rank-variable 表达式）；流内嵌重配置信息触发细粒度运行时调度；提出分布式链式流内存（DLSM）更有效利用片上内存、支持动态尺寸张量；重配置以 tile 流为粒度低频发生，动态维度处理开销极低。

关键数字：Llama 3-8B decode 层达 roofline 性能 92.6%（H100 为 69.7%）；DLSM 相比最优 cache 配置最多减少 61.4% 片外流量；分布式运行时调度器重叠依赖内核、内核对加速最高 1.42×；全层面积延迟积比传统空间加速器改善 6.34×–31.67×。

为什么值得看：动态 shape 负载的架构级解法，数据流加速器泛化到不规则负载的关键一步。

原文：Elasticy: A Runtime-Reconfigurable Architecture for Dynamic Streams

item.title: Efficient Poincaré Convolutions through Patch-Statistics Factorization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Published implementations of the Poincaré convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincaré ball before evaluating its score. We

Published implementations of the Poincaré convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincaré ball before evaluating its score. We show that the clipped score depends on each patch only through two statistics, its squared norm and its inner products with the filters, which a native convolution and a single-channel box filter compute directly. The factorized layer therefore evaluates the specified score exactly, without constructing ball-valued patches, and its single-precision outputs and gradients agree with double-precision evaluations at least as closely as those of the explicit reference. On an RTX A6000 under two versions of JAX, complete training updates of a Poincaré U-Net and a Poincaré ResNet-20 are 1.5 to 1.8 times faster than the faster of two explicit implementations that map patches to the ball (1.2 to 1.4 times against an explicit implementation that skips this mapping); on a V100, the gain over the gather-based one persists as the ResNet-20 is widened eightfold. In 15 paired training runs per task, updates are 2.0 and 1.8 times faster than a reference that follows the published execution order, with no consistent chan…

item.title: Disentangling Forgetting from Utility: Lightweight LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Null-Space Projection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific k

Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific knowledge without compromising general utility. However, prevailing fine-tuning-based unlearning methods struggle to achieve this balance, often suffering from computational inefficiency and unintended utility degradation due to the entangled nature of knowledge within model parameters. To disentangle forgetting from utility, we propose UUE, a theoretically grounded framework that reformulates unlearning as controllable model editing. First, UUE projects parameter updates into the orthogonal left null space of retained knowledge representations, strictly ensuring that the editing process causes minimal interference to the model's general capabilities. Second, distinct from targeted mapping, we introduce a convex untargeted objective that derives a closed-form analytical solution to effectively disrupt undesired knowledge by pushing forget-set embeddings toward their antipodal points. We implement UUE via lightweight, pluggable adapters (including a low-rank variant, UUE-L), enabling efficient deployment wi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘设备视觉数据爆炸需要极致压缩，扩散编解码器质量好但计算重、占用 NPU 且 I/O 路径长，如何软硬协同解决？

方法：DiffusionSSD 跨层近数据处理框架——算法层 Dual-stage Diffusion（patchification + 单步扩散）降低计算成本；架构层提出 cUFS（计算通用闪存）+ LPDDR-PIM，把编解码完全卸载到数据侧、减少视觉数据搬运且无需重设计 SoC；系统层 Patch-Workload 协同感知调度。

关键数字：Dual-stage Diffusion 保持相近感知质量同时计算成本最高降 92.7%；相比 NPU+DRAM，cUFS+PIM 编码吞吐平均提升 2.32×；相比 SmartSSD 平均提升 2.91×。

为什么值得看：闪存+存内计算承载神经编解码的软硬协同设计，边缘视觉压缩的新路线。

原文：DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing

item.title: Differentially Private Federated Class-Incremental Learning for EEG Mental State Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth inje

Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth injected noise. Personal biosignal applications such as wearable EEG instead involve small federations of a handful of subjects, a regime whose interaction with formal client-level DP is largely uncharacterized. We study differentially private federated class-incremental learning in this small-cohort regime, combining a public EEG dataset with a custom four-channel MUSE 2 recording set into a K=5-client federation, and give a masked per-class training protocol that avoids degenerate gradients and missing negative supervision under class-incremental streaming. We propose FedEEG, combining Synaptic-Intelligence consolidation with a lagged adaptive FedProx term, and show it reduces catastrophic forgetting relative to FedAvg, FedProx, and a federated Learning-without-Forgetting baseline; on-device balanced-batch replay reduces mean forgetting by a further 56.7%. A class-scoping diagnosis yields $50.5\%\pm3.6\%$ accuracy with 6 seeds and 2.02 times chance. We also introduce head-scoped client-level DP, which prote…
