item.title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-

A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. Early decay leaves a persistent weight-norm deficit, which keeps relative steps larger after the intervention ends. An approximate norm-dynamics recurrence captures the slow convergence of these relative steps, and fixed-norm replays of the measured trajectories reproduce the performance ordering and a similar loss difference. At 162M and 405M, norm-reset experiments show that smaller weight norms at the end of the decay window ex…

item.title: Deep Neural Networks Training Efficiency: Does Grokking Modify its Dynamics?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

We study whether grokking, the delayed emergence of out-of-distribution generalization after apparent overfitting, alters training efficiency in deep neural networks, where efficie

We study whether grokking, the delayed emergence of out-of-distribution generalization after apparent overfitting, alters training efficiency in deep neural networks, where efficiency is measured as accuracy per unit energy. Using two canonical settings, modular arithmetic and MNIST, we analyze two neural network models under 16-, 32-, and 64-bit precision and use Orthograd to test whether grokking produces noticeable deviations from the typically decreasing dynamics of training efficiency. We consider both short training runs of up to 500 epochs and long training runs of up to 20,000 epochs, and in both cases identify grokking as a sharp improvement in test accuracy after a sustained train-test gap. In the short-horizon experiments, applying Orthograd at progressively stronger levels during early training does not induce grokking, and efficiency remains smoothly decreasing. In the long-horizon experiments, Orthograd induces grokking, but the efficiency curves remain approximately monotonic and show no appreciable local increase at the grokking transition. These results suggest that, in our setting, grokking does not materially alter overall training-efficiency dynamics.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operation

The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operation

The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. Indeed, the persistence of latent codes predicts the qualitative structure of autocorrelations and accounts for most of the empirical measures. item.title: DeCompCert: A Verified Decompiler for CompCert-Generated AArch64
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：能否对 CompCert 生成的 AArch64 汇编做形式化验证的反编译，可靠还原出语义等价的 C 代码？

方法：DeCompCert 是 Rocq 验证的反编译器——通过 9 个逆向过程重构 CompCert C，结合演绎验证的变换与翻译验证；不可信的 OCaml/Datalog 分析提出候选重建，验证器只接受满足语义对应的候选；组合正确性定理保证：被接受 C 重建的每个已定义安全行为都被输入汇编匹配。

关键数字：约 216 万行 C 上评估；有精确函数与调用签名时，3,173 个合格上下文在未优化与优化流水线下全部重建重编译成功；无签名时累计推理组合验证 3,164 个中的 2,606 个（82.4%），平台+IDA 配置验证 2,407 个（76.1%）。

为什么值得看：反编译器形式化验证的里程碑，逆向工程与编译器验证交叉领域的重要进展。

原文：DeCompCert: A Verified Decompiler for CompCert-Generated AArch64

item.title: Coordinating Distributed AI Servers with Industrial Loads to Reduce Grid-Interconnection Needs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

将分布式AI服务器与工厂工业负荷协同调度，可减少约60%额外电网互联需求

We show that co-locating distributed AI servers with industrial demand and coordinating AI workloads with production loads can substantially reduce the additional grid interconnection that AI computing requires. Grid interconnection is increasingly constraining the expansion of large AI data centers. Factories already have grid connections sized for their peak production loads, and we propose hosting AI servers during production valleys. We formulate a joint optimization that sizes CPU and GPU servers, schedules deadline-constrained tasks, and routes tasks among factories, and use it to compare three factory-site architectures with new large data centers serving the same demand. Applying this framework to 31 Chinese manufacturing industries, we find that AI demand and production loads often do not peak together. As a result, AI servers placed at factories and scheduled according to production peaks need about 60% less additional interconnection capacity than new large data centers, and 98% less when tasks are routed among a group's factories.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Conflict, Feasibility, Faithfulness, Displacement: Four Quantities That Come Apart in Federated Dual-Cone Aggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

FedFV, FedGH and FedMGDA+ aggregate client updates with multi-objective gradient aggregators to remove conflict between them. We examine this rationale with UPGrad, which increases

FedFV, FedGH and FedMGDA+ aggregate client updates with multi-objective gradient aggregators to remove conflict between them. We examine this rationale with UPGrad, which increases no client's loss to first order, in a comparison that changes only the direction of FedAvg's update. Four quantities the rationale treats as one -- conflict between client updates, feasibility of their weighted mean, faithfulness of the transmitted updates to the clients' gradients, and displacement of the update -- come apart. Under Dirichlet partitioning UPGrad improves CIFAR-10 accuracy by +0.78 pp (14/15 seeds, p < 0.001), only with full participation; on Oxford-IIIT Pet its +0.52 pp gain vanishes (+0.07 pp) once the data our protocol left unused are kept. Varying only the Dirichlet concentration, the gain grows with heterogeneity, yet the split with the most conflict shows none. Uniform client weights, blind to conflict, match the CIFAR-10 gain and exceed the Pets gain; a matched random rotation does neither. No fairness effect survives multiplicity correction, and on CIFAR-10 the guarantee does not reach the clients' gradients. We state what evaluations should report.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：ML 系统为负载与硬件定制计算，但通信仍停留在通用库——其设备代码与传输决策对高层编译器不可见，无法协同优化。

方法：Obaleth 编译器把 GPU 发起的通信变成 kernel 中间表示的一部分，与计算协同优化并降级为专用传输代码；围绕 buffer 生命周期规划完成时机，跨 NVIDIA/AMD GPU 优化内存序、同步与批处理。

关键数字：H100 上小消息发送最快 3.3×；256 GPU 上 all-to-all 比 NVSHMEM 快 1.25×、比 NCCL GIN 快 2.3×，内存与寄存器占用更小；vLLM 中为 16 块 B200 上的 Qwen3-235B 服务，比 DeepEP 快 1.29×。

为什么值得看：把 GPU 通信纳入编译器优化视野，大模型分布式推理的通信开销有新解法。

原文：Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking

item.title: Compiling Matrix Formulas to Quantum Block Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Realizing the promise of quantum applications such as chemistry or fluid dynamics requires building quantum circuits that efficiently encode and manipulate exponentially large matr

Realizing the promise of quantum applications such as chemistry or fluid dynamics requires building quantum circuits that efficiently encode and manipulate exponentially large matrices. This process forces researchers to grapple with the reality that a matrix expressible as one equation on paper can map to thousands of bit-level quantum logic gates, historically written by hand. Even worse, it often ends with a discovery that the needed resources grow so quickly with matrix size that the quantum algorithm loses its asymptotic speedup. In this work, we present MARBLE, a language that automatically synthesizes an efficient circuit from the publication-style formula for the entries of a matrix. MARBLE algebraically rewrites programs into symbolic combinations of simpler matrices that have known circuit realizations. It analyzes costs of possible representations, notably the subnormalization term that dominates time complexity. It then emits an OpenQASM circuit and certifies whether its cost is poly-logarithmic in problem size, as required by quantum algorithms. When evaluated on quantum applications ranging from fluid dynamics to physical Hamiltonians, MARBLE matches or surpasses 37 o…

item.title: Clustering-Based Artificial Tree Ensembles for Random Forest Approximation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

聚类人工树集成用于随机森林近似

Random Forests (RFs) offer strong prediction performance but are difficult to interpret. Most representative trees (MRTs) and artificial representative trees (ARTs) provide surrogate explanations, but a single tree may miss patterns within a forest. We investigate benefits and limitations of clustering-based representative tree ensembles for RF surrogate modeling and assess the contribution of similarity-based clustering relative to random tree partitions. Using linear and nonlinear simulations and regression benchmarks, we evaluate fidelity, prediction accuracy, complexity, and prediction stability against equally sized ensembles of top-ranked MRTs and randomly selected trees. Increasing ensemble size generally improves fidelity, accuracy, and prediction stability. ART ensembles show higher fidelity in simulations and often greater prediction stability for small ensembles. Compared with random tree partitions, similarity-based clustering generally improves ART fidelity in simulations and often on benchmarks. On benchmark datasets, MRT-based ensembles generally achieve higher fidelity and prediction accuracy, whereas ART ensembles have fewer terminal nodes. ART ensembles provide co…

item.title: Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed o

A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed order that nobody placed. Our companion work calls the second kind a silent error, and it is the dangerous one. We present a web demo in which a fine-tuned 0.8B parameter model runs entirely inside the visitor's browser tab, through llama.cpp compiled to WebAssembly. No order text leaves the device. The page parses orders as the visitor types, scores every ticket with the PIZZA benchmark's own matcher ported to TypeScript, refuses anything off the menu with "?" so the model can face the open web, and lets visitors hunt for silent errors or try to cause one. Run in the browser on all 1,357 PIZZA test orders, the deployed model writes the same output as the server evaluation for 99.0% of them and reaches the same exact match (0.882); we also report its latency on 3 consumer laptops. Demo: https://wrong.cuyor.com

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Challenges of building machine learning compilers across varying hardware architecture
item.description:
发表方：Microsoft DirectX Developer Blog　发布：2026-11-13　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：构建跨硬件架构 ML 编译器的挑战——如何同时做到可扩展与高性能。

要点：现有方案（IHV 专有框架、torch.compile、MLIR/Glow/EON 等）各有侧重，但很少独立于硬件厂商与框架同时高性能；图→kernel 映射直观但难以跨演进硬件扩展；MMA 等核心算子需要多级 IR 渐进 lowering，叠加设备无关/设备感知优化、融合/分解、调度与内存管理；兼顾模块化与设备特化的代码生成是主要难点。

关键数字：正文未给量化数字（工程挑战综述）。

为什么值得看：微软官方梳理 ML 编译器设计空间，并预告 Ignite 2026 BRK388——多级 IR 对 Windows 本地 AI 的意义。

原文：Challenges of building machine learning compilers across varying hardware architectures

item.title: Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：agent 会话频繁编辑上下文会失效 KV cache，请求被迫等待重新 prefill 才能开始 decode，如何降低这段延迟？

方法：Callo 分离式 serving 系统——利用失效的 KV 生成投机草稿（speculative drafts），prefill 完成后对照精确 KV 验证再提交 token；在 decode 资源空闲期调度投机、草稿可能不被接受时主动抢占，提高 decode 资源利用率。

关键数字：双 GPU 测试台 + SWE-agent 会话、三个模型族，中等负载下相对 vLLM 全体请求加速 1.05–1.19×；真实 trace 驱动的集群级模拟验证收益可扩展到大规模。

为什么值得看：把「失效 KV」变废为宝做投机解码，prefill-decode 分离架构下的新优化点。

原文：Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation

item.title: CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘 AI 加速器效率受数据搬运限制，前期 CHARM 用计算与搬运重叠缓解，能否进一步用存内计算作为并行加速器、彻底消除部分数据搬运？

方法：CHARMING 异构边缘 AI 架构——基于精度与量化感知的划分，把注意力头分配到 AIE 阵列与 in-DRAM 计算单元上并发执行；按模型结构、序列长度与精度平衡负载并挑选头以最小化精度损失；把量化集成进 AIE 投影阶段进一步减少数据搬运。

关键数字：AMD Versal VCK5000 与 Alveo U200 硬件端到端验证；prefill 性能最高提升 23.6%、decode 最高 44%；int4×int4 定点存内计算下每层能耗最高降 7.6%、能耗延迟积改善最多 24.7%，精度接近 FP32 基线。

为什么值得看：AIE+存内计算并行加速的硬件实测方案，边缘 LLM/视频生成推理的新架构思路。

原文：CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation

发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘 AI 加速器效率受数据搬运限制，前期 CHARM 用计算与搬运重叠缓解，能否进一步用存内计算作为并行加速器、彻底消除部分数据搬运？

方法：CHARMING 异构边缘 AI 架构——基于精度与量化感知的划分，把注意力头分配到 AIE 阵列与 in-DRAM 计算单元上并发执行；按模型结构、序列长度与精度平衡负载并挑选头以最小化精度损失；把量化集成进 AIE 投影阶段进一步减少数据搬运。

关键数字：AMD Versal VCK5000 与 Alveo U200 硬件端到端验证；prefill 性能最高提升 23.6%、decode 最高 44%；int4×int4 定点存内计算下每层能耗最高降 7.6%、能耗延迟积改善最多 24.7%，精度接近 FP32 基线。

为什么值得看：AIE+存内计算并行加速的硬件实测方案，边缘 LLM/视频生成推理的新架构思路。

原文：CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation

item.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble me

Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemic decomposition in principle, but are computationally prohibitive at LLM scale and require white-box access. Existing black-box methods, in contrast, summarize to a single scalar that cannot make the distinction. We introduce a two-level ensemble that bridges this gap. Stochastic decoding of a fixed prompt forms the inner ensemble; meaning-preserving semantic perturbations of the prompt form the outer ensemble. Variability is measured in a continuous embedding space, and the law of total covariance gives an exact within-/between-perturbation decomposition to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty (AU/EU); it requires only black-box sampling access. On top of this estimator, we contribute three theoretical results that ground the framework: (i) a finite-sample bias identity for nested Monte Carlo with a closed-form bias-corrected epistemic estimator; (ii) a Bayesian bridge bounding the gap between perturbation-population AU/EU and Bayesian targets; and (iii) a sep…

item.title: Bilateral Log-Linear Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

双边对数线性注意力

Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage a…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond Blossom: Accelerating MWPM Decoding for Surface Codes With Local Predecoding and Architecture-Aware Optimizations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) is widely used to decode surface codes, but its computational cost increases with code distance. We present Beyond Blossom, a state-of-the-ar

Minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) is widely used to decode surface codes, but its computational cost increases with code distance. We present Beyond Blossom, a state-of-the-art CPU-based MWPM decoder for surface codes. It combines algorithmic optimization through local predecoding, architecture-aware optimization, and pipeline-wide parallelism to reduce matching workload and execution overhead while preserving MWPM optimality. Across rotated surface codes with distances 9-33 and circuit-level physical error rates of 0.05%-0.3%, on a single CPU core, Beyond Blossom achieves a 4.23$\times$ geometric-mean speedup and up to 5.58$\times$ speedup over Sparse Blossom in PyMatching. At distance 33 and a physical error rate of 0.1%, with 8 CPU cores, decoding a block of 33 measurement rounds takes 21.40 $μ$s on average, equivalent to 0.65 $μ$s per round.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BPU-SpikeMM:Exact Matrix Multiplication via Spatio-Temporal Spike Encoding on Real Neuromorphic Hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Matrix multiplication is the dominant computational kernel in deep learning, yet its growing scale strains conventional von Neumann hardware in energy efficiency and bandwidth. Neu

Matrix multiplication is the dominant computational kernel in deep learning, yet its growing scale strains conventional von Neumann hardware in energy efficiency and bandwidth. Neuromorphic architectures offer a promising alternative, but mathematical equivalence between matrix multiplication and spiking computation does not guarantee direct execution on real neuromorphic hardware, as the specific hardware paradigm may still require additional data recovery, bit-weight reconstruction, or state readout after neuromorphic execution. This paper presents BPU-SpikeMM (Brain Processing Unit-based Spike Matrix Multiplication), an exact spatio-temporal spike encoding framework for matrix multiplication on real neuromorphic hardware. We prove the exact equivalence of spike-encoded matrix multiplication under the BPU execution paradigm, distinguish mathematical equivalence from native direct-readout equivalence on BPU hardware, and build a spatio-temporal offloading pipeline supporting multiple encoding schemes. Furthermore, we extend the framework to a multi-dimensional encoding design space and evaluate the applicability of different encodings on real BPU hardware in terms of correctness, …

item.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Ascend NPU 上 kernel 优化缺少面向真实负载的评测基准——现有基准侧重 kernel 生成，很少评估 agent 在真实输入配置下优化既有实现的能力。

方法：AscendGYM 基准，初始 48 个 kernel 分三档难度；每个 kernel 配的测试用例数据类型与张量形状取自真实训练/推理任务，性能提升可直接映射到对应负载；支持模型评估与 model-harness 评估两种模式，内置 harness 带搜索编排与经验积累；提出新指标 Speedup-Token Score (STS)，联合考虑加速比与 token 成本。

关键数字：48 个 kernel、三档难度、真实负载形状；STS 衡量预算内实际 kernel 优化能力；代码开源在 github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM。

为什么值得看：昇腾生态首个面向 agent 的真实负载 kernel 优化基准，做 kernel 自动调优的人值得关注。

原文：AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs

item.title: Analyzing Learning-Dynamics Across Loss and Prediction Choices for Diffusion Models
item.description:

Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($\epsilon$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting ni

Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($ε$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting nine combinations are algebraically related, they can yield substantially different denoising accuracy and sample quality. We disentangle the effects of prediction and loss spaces. For a fixed prediction target, we show that changing the loss space is exactly equivalent to timestep reweighting and provide a heuristic analysis of how this reweighting affects generation quality. We then show that a rank-$m$ linear bottleneck compressing a $D$-dimensional noisy input imposes an irreducible squared-error floor of $D-m$ on noise and velocity prediction, whereas clean-data prediction can exploit low-dimensional data structure. Combining this bound with prediction-dependent error conversion yields distinct necessary conditions on bottleneck capacity. Experiments with U-Net and JiT across CIFAR-10, Imagenette, and ImageNet-256 support these theoretical predictions. Under compression, prediction choice strongly affects both denoising accuracy and sample quality, with noise-prediction errors closely matching the theoretical…

item.title: Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

非对称双模型推进LLM分类器校准-计算前沿

The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration-aware techniques, meaning it can be easily combined with them to consistently boost their performance. Finally, our analysis of the logit-space behavior illustrates how asymmetric fusion successfully mitigates base model overconfidence. Overall, ou…

item.title: A Unified Device-Level Physical Framework for DRAM Read Disturbance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-13　分类：论文PDF

Read disturbance in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) depends on both local device interactions and the electrical conditions imposed by shared array circuitry. Here, we combine

Read disturbance in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) depends on both local device interactions and the electrical conditions imposed by shared array circuitry. Here, we combine DIMM-level characterization results, device measurements, and TCAD simulations to interpret RowHammer, RowPress, and ColumnDisturb within a unified device-level physical framework. We relate charge evolution at the floating storage node to three key mechanisms: trap-assisted electron migration (EM), capacitive coupling (CC), and sense-amplifier-mediated disturb (SAMD). EM is local and trap-sensitive, while CC weakens with wordline separation. SAMD extends disturbance through shared column circuitry by modifying unselected-cell leakage under rail-level bitline biases, a contribution supported by the approximately ninefold higher OFF-state leakage measured relative to retention-like conditions for a high-voltage storage state. These distinct spatial ranges account for localized RowHammer and RowPress failures and remote ColumnDisturb populations with abrupt changes at subarray boundaries. We further interpret prolonged RowPress activation as a transition from an initial RowHammer-like transient to sustained…

item.title: Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. Comparisons with random and magnitude-based sparse perturbations further highlight the importance of informative support selection.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
